), producing high-retention: true crime and police i
 breakdowns. This is NOT a raw bodycam dump channel. We do not just stitch together dashcam clips with automated captions. Our goal is maximum viewer retention (50%+ AVD). Every video must be edited like a fast-paced psychological thriller documentary and investigative legal breakdown.

.

title: Online Sales Specialist (Chat, DM & Phone) — Early Morning Shift, Long-Term
description:
About us



Aquae Jewels is an online jewelry brand. Our customers reach out every day through WhatsApp, Instagram DMs, our website chat,
, and phone — and we're looking for one sharp, personable salesperson to own those conversations and turn interest into sales.  EXCELLENT COMMAND OF ENGLISH, BOTH SPOKEN AND WRITTEN, IS REQUIRED.

This is a real sales role, not just support. You'll be the voice of the brand, guiding customers, answering questions, handling objections, and closing orders. Because it's commission-driven, the better you sell, the more you earn — and your commission is uncapped.



What you'll do



Respond quickly and warmly to customer messages across WhatsApp, Instagram DM, website live chat,
, and phone

Answer product questions, recommend pieces, handle objections, and close sales

Follow up with interested customers who haven't yet purchased

Keep conversations organized and log outcomes

Represent Aquae Jewels professionally in every interaction



Schedule



Approx. 5:00 AM – 1:00 PM Manila time (this aligns with our Dubai hours, from 1:00 AM Dubai onward)

6 days per week

This is an early-morning shift — you must be a reliable early riser



Compensation



Base: $550/month, paid reliably

Commission: uncapped, tiered — 3% of the sales you handle up to your monthly target, and 5% on everything above it

13th-month bonus and performance incentives

Strong closers realistically earn $1,500–$2,500+/month total



What we're looking for



Proven experience in online/e-commerce sales or chat-based sales (WhatsApp, Instagram, or live chat)

Excellent written English — friendly, clear, and persuasive

Comfortable and confident on phone calls

A genuine closer: you enjoy selling and chasing targets, not just answering questions

Reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection, plus a quiet place to work

Able to commit to the early-morning shift, 6 days a week, long-term



How to apply



Please do the following so we know you read this carefully:



Start your application with the word "AQUAE" at the very top.

Tell us in a few sentences about your best month in sales — what you sold, how much, and how you did it.

Answer these three questions:

Which sales channels have you worked with (WhatsApp / Instagram / live chat / phone /
)?

Are you able to work 5:00 AM–1:00 PM Manila time, 6 days a week?

Describe your internet setup (provider, speed, and backup).

Short paid test: Shortlisted applicants will be paid a small fee to reply to 3 sample customer messages, so we can see your selling style in action.



Applications that don't start with "AQUAE" won't be reviewed. We're hiring for the long term and want someone who'll grow with us.

title: Cold Email & Lead Gen Specialist (Instantly) — Fix Deliverability, English Market

 accounts, and we run cold

s are landing in spam, some inboxes are getting blocked, and campaigns aren't performing.

s OUT of spam and optimize continuously for replies

3. Tell me your hands-on experience with Instantly, lead gen, and deliverability (warm-up, SPF/DKIM/DMARC).



Generic copy-paste applications will be deleted.

title: FEMALE Performance Video Editor — Paid Social
description:
D2C Jewelry · Remote · Independent Contractor · GMT+8 Overlap Required



Who we are

We are a fast-growing demi-fine jewelry brand creating earrings women can actually live in.



Our hero product, the Stay Close Hoop, is a backless hoop designed for comfortable, uninterrupted wear. We've served 175,000+ customers across the US, UK, Australia, Canada and Europe, backed by 7,000+ five-star reviews.



We're looking for a female video editor with exceptional taste in content made for women to join our creative team.



The role

- You'll work alongside a Creative Strategist to turn briefs into high-performing Meta and TikTok ads.

- This role sits at the intersection of aesthetic taste and performance creative.

- You need to understand the visual world our female customer lives in — jewelry, beauty, fashion, lifestyle, GRWM and creator content — while also knowing how to make an ad hook, hold attention and convert.

- We're not looking for cinematic brand films.

- We're looking for beautiful ads that sell.



What you'll do



Edit paid social ads at volume.

Turn structured creative briefs into compelling short-form ads using creator/UGC footage, product footage, testimonials, photography and other assets.



Make jewelry desirable.

Have a strong eye for product close-ups, ear stacks, styling, composition, typography, music and shot selection. You should instinctively know which shot makes someone think: I want those earrings.



Create content native to women's feeds.

Your work should feel at home alongside the jewelry, beauty, fashion and lifestyle content women already consume on TikTok and Instagram — not like a traditional advertisement dropped into their feed.



Build variants of winners.

Create new hooks, openings, pacing, overlays, product reveals, testimonials and CTAs around proven concepts so we can systematically find what improves performance.



Turn raw UGC into great ads.

Find the strongest hooks, reactions, product moments and soundbites from creator footage and restructure them into ads that feel natural while still selling.



Use AI where useful.

AI isn't the focus of the role, but you should be comfortable using modern image/video and voice tools when they can efficiently fill a footage gap or improve an edit.



Learn from performance.

You'll see how your ads perform and should understand metrics like hook rate, hold rate, CTR and CPA well enough to form a point of view on what worked and what to test next.



What we're looking for

- Exceptional female-focused aesthetic taste. Your portfolio must demonstrate strong TikTok or Instagram content created for female audiences. Jewelry, beauty, fashion and lifestyle experience is highly relevant.

- Paid social experience. You've edited performance ads for a D2C/e-commerce brand or performance agency and understand that creative ultimately gets judged by results.

- Strong short-form instincts. You understand hooks, retention, pacing, mobile-first typography, product reveals, UGC storytelling and direct-response structure.

- Speed. You can produce and iterate quickly without becoming sloppy. You know which details affect performance and which don't.

- Ownership. You don't blindly execute briefs. If a hook isn't working visually or the footage isn't supporting the concept, you flag it and propose a solution

- Organization. You're comfortable managing multiple concepts and variants with clean naming, version control and ClickUp handoffs.



We're tool-agnostic — Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci, CapCut or similar are all fine.



Nice to have: jewelry/beauty/fashion experience, motion graphics, TikTok Spark Ads, AI-assisted production and localization experience.



Who you'll work with

- You'll work inside an ARDANT creative pod, led by a Creative Strategist and potentially alongside other Video Editors.

The strategist owns the audience, angle and persuasion strategy.

- You own making it visually compelling enough to stop someone and clear enough to sell.



Who this isn't for

- This isn't the right role if your strongest work is long-form brand films, you don't regularly consume female-focused TikTok/Instagram content, you need weeks to finish an asset, or you dislike creating multiple iterations of the same concept.



At ARDANT, creative gets tested quickly.



We care less about defending an edit and more about finding the edit that wins.



Logistics

Engagement: Independent contractor

Location: Fully remote

Timezone: Meaningful GMT+8 overlap required

Compensation: Monthly fee + performance bonus

Tools: Required software/AI credits covered by ARDANT



How to apply

Keep it simple. Send us:



1. Your portfolio

Show us your best TikTok/Instagram work, especially content created for female audiences in jewelry, beauty, fashion or lifestyle.



2. Your best 3 paid social ads

For each, tell us in one or two sentences what you edited and, if available, how it performed.



3. One sentence:

What's one thing most video editors get wrong when creating ads for women?



That's it.



Paid test

Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid ARDANT editing test using a real brief, raw creator footage and product assets.



We'll evaluate:



Aesthetic Taste · Hook Execution · Product Presentation · Pacing · Performance Thinking · Speed



We're not looking for the fanciest editor.



We're looking for someone who can consistently turn an ARDANT brief into an ad women want to watch and buy from.

title: Senior Media Buyer
description:
# Senior Media Buyer – Meta Ads / Google Ads



**Velnoriz** is looking for an experienced **Senior Media Buyer** to take ownership of our paid advertising and help us scale profitable growth across digital channels.



We are looking for a **hands-on, performance-driven media buyer** who can analyze campaign data, identify growth opportunities, optimize campaigns, and confidently scale what works.



This is a **long-term, remote, part-time position**, approximately **20–25 hours per week**, for someone who can work independently and take full ownership of paid media performance.



## What You'll Do



### Paid Media Strategy & Campaign Management



* Develop and execute paid media strategies aligned with business and revenue goals.

* Set up, manage, optimize, and scale campaigns across **Meta Ads and/or Google Ads**.

* Manage campaign structure, audiences, budgets, bidding, targeting, and creatives.

* Continuously test new audiences, creatives, offers, campaign structures, and optimization strategies.

* Identify winning campaigns and scale them profitably.

* Quickly identify underperforming campaigns and take corrective action.



### Meta Ads



* Manage campaigns from initial setup through optimization and scaling.

* Research audiences and identify new targeting opportunities.

* Test creatives, ad copy, audiences, placements, and campaign structures.

* Monitor and optimize **CTR, CPC, CPA, CPL, ROAS, conversion rate, and CAC**.

* Conduct A/B tests and make decisions based on performance data.



### Google Ads



* Manage and optimize **Search, Performance Max, Display, and Remarketing** campaigns where appropriate.

* Conduct keyword research and analyze search intent.

* Optimize keywords, bids, budgets, ad copy, audiences, and landing pages.

* Test different bidding and campaign strategies to improve profitability and scale.



### Reporting & Performance Analysis



* Monitor campaign performance, spending, revenue, and profitability.

* Analyze data and turn insights into clear actions.

* Track key KPIs including **CPA, CAC, ROAS, conversion rate, and revenue**.

* Provide regular performance updates and recommendations.

* Take ownership of results rather than simply managing campaigns.



## What We're Looking For



* **3+ years of professional experience** in media buying, paid media, or performance marketing.

* Strong hands-on experience with **Meta Ads and/or Google Ads**.

* Proven experience **optimizing and scaling profitable campaigns**.

* Strong understanding of performance marketing metrics such as **CTR, CPC, CPA, CAC, ROAS, and conversion rate**.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Experience managing meaningful advertising budgets.

* Strong understanding of A/B testing, audience segmentation, bidding strategies, and campaign optimization.

* Ability to work independently without constant supervision.

* Strong written communication and reporting skills.

* Proactive, accountable, and highly performance-oriented.



### Strongly Preferred



* Experience managing **both Meta Ads and Google Ads**.

* Experience scaling campaigns while maintaining profitability.

* Experience working with significant monthly ad spend.

* Experience in e-commerce, lead generation, or other performance-driven businesses.

* Strong understanding of conversion tracking, attribution, and landing-page performance.



## What We Offer



**Compensation: $2,000–$2,300 USD/month**



Compensation will be based on experience, technical skills, and demonstrated campaign performance.



* **Employment:** Part-time

* **Location:** Remote

* **Hours:** Approximately 20–25 hours/week

* **Schedule:** Flexible

* **Long-term opportunity**

* Opportunity to take significant ownership of paid media performance and growth.



## How to Apply



Please send us:



1. **Your CV or professional profile**

2. A brief summary of your media buying experience

3. The platforms you have managed (**Meta Ads, Google Ads, or both**)

4. The approximate **monthly ad spend/budget** you have personally managed

5. **1–3 examples of campaigns you personally managed or scaled**

6. Key results you achieved, such as:



   * ROAS

   * CPA/CAC reduction

   * Revenue growth

   * Conversion rate improvement

   * Monthly advertising spend managed



### Please also answer these questions:



**1. What is the largest monthly advertising budget you have personally managed?**



**2. What is one campaign you successfully scaled, and what were the key results?**



**3. Which platform are you strongest at: Meta Ads, Google Ads, or both?**

title: Lead Researcher / List Builder – Amazon Seller Leads (Verified Emails, No Duplicates)

We are a Dubai-based e-commerce consultancy working with Amazon brands and sellers in Germany, the UK and the US. We need someone who builds clean, verified lead lists of Amazon sellers for our outbound campaigns.



This is detail work. We do not need volume. We need lists we can load into our sending tool without cleaning them first.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Research Amazon third-party sellers and brands and deliver them in a Google Sheet with these exact columns:



First Name

Last Name

Job Title


LinkedIn URL

Company Name

Amazon Seller Page (storefront or brand page URL)

Company Country

Seller Type (Private Label / Brand Owner / Reseller / Aggregator / Agency)

Company Website

Employees

Company LinkedIn URL

Monthly Revenue (estimate)

Review Rating



QUALITY RULES (this is what the job is really about)



1. Right person, not just any person. We need the decision maker: Founder, Owner, CEO, Managing Director, Head of E-Commerce, Amazon Manager, Marketplace Manager. Not interns, not warehouse staff, not accountants. If a company has no reachable decision maker, skip it.



2. Verified
s only. Every personal
 must be run through a verification tool (NeverBounce, MillionVerifier, ZeroBounce or similar) and marked as valid. "Accept-all" or "risky" results are not acceptable and must be excluded, not included with a note. Our bounce rate must stay under 2 percent.



3. Zero duplicates. No duplicate
s, no duplicate companies, no duplicate domains across the whole list AND against the master list we give you. You dedupe before you deliver, not us.



4. Amazon Seller Page is mandatory. If you cannot find the actual Amazon storefront or brand page of the company, the lead does not go on the list. This is our most important filter. A company that "probably sells on Amazon" is not a lead.



5. Revenue estimate must come from a source. Use Helium 10, Jungle Scout, SellerAmp, Keepa, Similarweb or public company data. Write the source in a notes column. Never guess.



6. Data must be clean. Correct spelling and capitalisation of first names (we use them in
 personalisation, so "MARIA" or "maria" or "M. Schmidt" is a fail), no trailing spaces, consistent country names, working URLs.



TOOLS

You should be comfortable with at least some of: 
, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, 
, 
, Clay, Helium 10 / Jungle Scout / Keepa, Google Sheets. Tell us which ones you have access to and which ones we would need to provide.



WHO THIS IS FOR

You are a good fit if you are patient, precise, and you would rather deliver 100 perfect leads than 500 messy ones. You check your own work before you send it. You ask questions when a rule is unclear instead of guessing.



You are not a good fit if you plan to scrape a database, export it and send it over unverified. We check every list we receive.



HOURS AND START

Start part time, around 20 hours per week, with a fixed weekly delivery target we agree together. If the quality is right, this becomes a long-term full-time role with a raise. We pay on time, every time.



HOW TO APPLY

Please do not send a generic application. Answer these in your message:



1. Put the word AMAZON-LIST in the first line of your application, so we know you read this.

2. Which tools do you currently have paid access to?

3. How do you verify an
 before putting it on a list? Name the tool and the exact steps.

4. How would you find the Amazon storefront of a brand when the brand does not link to it from their website?

Applications without the sample will not be reviewed.

title: Senior Local SEO Lead - UK Trades & Home Services
description:
Local Launchpad helps UK local service businesses; landscapers, roofers, electricians, plumbers, cleaners and similar trades, dominate Google through high-converting websites, SEO and Google Business Profile optimisation.



We launched in June, already have paying clients, and are building this to scale toward hundreds.



Everything runs on systems. We have our own AI copy system that generates website copy, meta titles and descriptions, schema and GBP content for every client, with content pushed directly into WordPress. Sites can go live in days, not weeks. At least that is the aim, we are not quite there just yet.



We're now looking for someone to own SEO across the entire business. Not a task-doer. Not someone waiting for an SEO checklist.



We want the person who d
 what good looks like, builds the methodology behind it, and makes sure every website and GBP we ship is technically and strategically right from the ground up.



Feel free to take a look at our landing page to get a better understanding of Local Launchpad: 
  





—-





YOUR FIRST JOB: TELL US WHAT WE'RE GETTING WRONG



We already run a documented SEO methodology — H1 formulas, page architecture rules, mandatory on-page signals, GBP category handling. It works well enough to get clients ranking. But it was largely inherited and has never been stress-tested by someone who genuinely knows their stuff.



Your first task is to audit it honestly and tell us what's right, what's outdated, and what's actively costing our clients rankings. We'd rather hear it now than in six months.





—-





WHAT YOU'LL OWN



Site architecture and keyword strategy

Keyword research, search-intent analysis, competitor and SERP research, keyword-to-page mapping, URL structure and internal linking. D
 how homepage, service, category, location and service × location pages should be structured and targeted and what copy belongs to each page, where, how long it should be and what it needs to say — and critically, d
 which pages shouldn't exist at all. We don't want to create hundreds of pages just because we can. You need to know when a page has genuine value and how to build scalable local architectures without producing thin or duplicate content.



On-page and copy frameworks

Working directly with our WordPress designer to define what every page type needs before it's built, so SEO is designed into the templates rather than bolted on later. You won't hand-write hundreds of pages — our copy bot handles generation at scale and can be tailored to your suggestions. What you will own is the framework behind it: section mapping, keyword targeting, heading structure, copy briefs, local relevance, entity coverage, FAQs, alt text, anchor text, and quality control on what comes out the other end.



Technical SEO

Crawling and indexing, Search Console, sitemaps, robots.txt, canonicals, redirects, duplicate content, index/noindex decisions, Core Web Vitals, schema, breadcrumbs, crawl depth. You don't need to be the developer, you need to identify issues, explain the fix, and work with our developer to get it implemented correctly.



Existing website migrations

Many clients arrive with an existing site. You'll audit it before anything is replaced and d
 which URLs have real value (rankings, traffic, backlinks), which must be preserved, which get consolidated or removed, and how to sequence the switch. We will not wipe out years of a client's SEO value because a migration was done carelessly.



Google Business Profile and local

This is central to the offer. Setup and optimisation, category selection, services, service areas, photo strategy, review generation and response, NAP consistency, GBP-to-website alignment, Local Pack and Maps rankings, citations, competitor analysis, and resolving GBP issues when they arise. UK knowledge is a real advantage — some categories carry protected-title or accreditation traps. We use or plan to use tools like LeadSnap and are open to whatever you'd recommend.



Off-page and authority

Citations, local and niche-relevant links, competitor backlink analysis, partnerships and outreach where it makes sense. We are not interested in buying hundreds of low-quality links a month. We want a repeatable, commercially sensible authority strategy.



Measurement

Search Console, Analytics, GBP data, rank tracking, Ahrefs or Semrush, Screaming Frog. What's improving, what's declining, what's sitting just outside the top positions, and what's actually generating leads. We don't care about vanity metrics — we care about qualified calls for our clients. We also need to be able to show our clients on a monthly/quarterly basis the results we have generated for them, this task will sit with you.





—-





WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

- Real, demonstrable local SEO experience, ideally with trades and home services — landscapers, roofers, plumbers, electricians, HVAC, cleaning, pest control, drainage and or similar. UK experience is a advantage, but we're open to exceptional candidates anywhere.



- Strong technically, strong on-page, and genuinely hands-on with Google Business Profile — not theoretical.



- Comfortable with WordPress and able to work directly with a designer/developer, setting requirements they implement.



- Able to work at our speed. Sites go live within days of onboarding, so if your process needs three weeks of research per client, this won't be a fit.



- The confidence to tell us we're wrong. We've had people give us confident answers that turned out to be incorrect, and it cost us real time and money. Push back.



- Proactive communication. Daily or near-daily updates, a weekly call, and a heads-up when something slips before it slips — not after.



- Excellent written English. You'll be working directly with me.

Interested in building systems, not just completing tasks.



- Most importantly: think like an owner of the result. If something isn't ranking, we don't want "I completed all my SEO tasks." We want "why isn't it ranking, and what are we doing about it?" This is crucial!





—-





THE OPPORTUNITY



This isn't a freelance gig where we send you random tasks. The right person becomes the SEO Lead behind Local Launchpad.



You'll start by working closely with me and our designer to audit and rebuild our delivery model. From there, the goal is a repeatable SEO system deployable across hundreds of businesses — architecture standards, keyword processes, page mapping, content frameworks, technical checklists, GBP and review systems, migration procedures, QA and reporting.



As we grow, there's scope to lead SEO team members beneath you rather than executing every repetitive task yourself. For the right person this becomes a significant long-term role, with genuine profit share as we scale.



$1000 for the set up of our SEO system with an ongoing monthly retainer and profit share agreed once the set up project has been completed!



A paid test task before either side commits may be required.





—-





HOW TO APPLY



Start your reply with "RANKINGS" so I know you've read the whole post, and open with 2–3 specific results you've achieved for local service businesses — the situation, what you did, and what actually changed. This comes first, before anything else. Applications without it won't be considered.



Then:

1- Your local SEO background — how long, what markets, what types of business



2- Your GBP experience, including tools you use for posting, reviews or rank tracking



3- A client serves 10 locations and offers 8 services. How would you structure that site, and how would you avoid thin or duplicate content? (Be specific — this is the question that matters most to us.)



4- A client comes to us with an existing 20-page site that ranks reasonably well. Walk me through your migration process.



5- Your availability and hours per week



Looking forward to finding the right person and building something great together.

title: Backend Operations Specialist (GoHighLevel, Zapier, Notion) — Systems Build
description:
**Backend Operations Specialist — GoHighLevel, Zapier, Notion,Miro (part-time moving to full-time)**



I run a growth agency. We build and run the entire client acquisition system for insurance advisors and agency owners in Canada — ads, CRM, funnels, automated follow-up, booking, reporting. When a client signs, we have five days to get their whole system built, tested and live. I need one person who can own that build end to end.



Read this part first, because it saves us both time. This is not a general VA role and it is not entry level. If your experience is ecommerce stores, dropshipping, Shopify, posting on social media or general admin, this is not for you and I will not review your application. I want someone who has actually built systems inside a business, and ideally someone who has worked in or around insurance, finance or professional services, because the details matter more in that world and you'll already understand why.



**The stack you'll be living in**



GoHighLevel. Calendly. Zapier. 
. Notion. Slack. Google Drive. Miro. Lovable. Appointwise. Whop. Meta Business Manager (access and tracking setup only — you won't be running campaigns). You don't need to be an expert in every one on day one, but you need to genuinely know most of them and be the kind of person who learns the rest in a weekend rather than asking me for a tutorial.



**What the job actually is**



For each new client, you build the system:



- Spin up the GoHighLevel sub-account, load our snapshot, and check everything came across connected and correct.

- Map the lead form into the pipeline — field mapping, routing, nothing landing in the wrong place.

- Build the booking calendars. Availability, buffers, round robin when there's more than one advisor, and confirmed two-way sync so appointments land in the advisor's own diary and their busy time blocks out. Calendly workflow experience matters here — if you've built booking flows with routing, reminders and reschedule logic, say so.

- Build the confirmation and reminder sequences. Show rate is the number our whole offer is judged on, and these are what protect it.

- Configure the 60-second speed-to-lead response so a new lead gets contacted inside a minute.

- Build the AI booking agent per client — qualification questions, booking logic, tone.

- Load the
 and SMS nurture sequences into the account.

- Set up the reporting dashboard, conversion tracking and internal notification rules.

- QA the whole thing yourself. Submit a real lead through the funnel. Confirm the 60-second response fires, the appointment books into the right calendar, the reminders go out, every form and redirect works. Then send me a screen recording of it working.



Alongside that, you keep the machine itself running: Zapier and 
 scenarios connecting GHL, Slack, Notion and our payment system, the Notion workspace (client portals, task database, filtered views, SOP library), system maps in Miro, and short screen-recorded SOPs so the next person doesn't have to ask.



**How I work, and what I expect**



To be clear about the scope: you are not writing ad copy, making creatives or running ad accounts. Other people handle that side. This role is purely backend — the systems, the automations, the builds, the QA and the admin that sit behind everything. The brief arrives with you clean. Your job is to build it properly and make sure it works.



I give clear tasks. In return I expect them acknowledged quickly during your hours, and I expect to be told before a deadline that something is going to overrun, not after. If a task is going to take three days, tell me on day one. Nothing gets marked done unless you have tested it yourself, on desktop and mobile. When you send your application, title it "Backend Ops — [the tool you are strongest in]" so I know you read this far. I would much rather have someone who asks one good question up front than someone who disappears for two days and comes back having built the wrong thing. Speed matters here because of the five-day clock, but a fast sloppy build costs me a client. I need both.



**What I'm looking for**



- Excellent written and spoken English. Non-negotiable. You'll be writing SOPs, documenting builds and communicating with me every day. If your English is only okay, you will struggle here.

- Real hands-on GoHighLevel. Tell me what you've built in it, not that you're familiar with it.

- Calendly and calendar/booking workflow experience — routing, reminders, sync.

- Genuine automation experience in Zapier — multi-step workflows with error handling and proper filtering, not one-step Zaps. 
 on top of that is a real plus, since some of our scenarios already run there.

- Strong Notion: databases, relations, filtered views, templates.

- Comfortable building in Miro.

- Experience in insurance, finance or corporate professional services is a big advantage and puts you near the top of the pile.

- Self-directed. I'm hiring so there's less on my plate, not more.



**The terms, plainly**



Starts part-time, around 20 hours a week, on my hours (Ireland time). We're launching a new offer right now so the workload builds over the next couple of months, and I expect this to go full-time within roughly two months, replacing my current backend person entirely. Pay starts at $5/hour. I'm not going to dress that up — that's the starting rate while we find out whether you're good. If you are, the hours go up first and the rate goes up after. This role grows into running operations here. If you're looking for short-term work or juggling five other clients, please don't apply.



**How to apply**



1. A Loom video, 2 to 3 minutes, unscripted, walking me through one system or automation you personally built. Show the actual build. What it does, why you built it that way, and what broke while you were building it. No Loom, no review.

2. A short list of what you've built in GoHighLevel.

3. Which of the tools above you've used, and which you haven't. Be honest — I'd rather know.

4. What kind of businesses you've worked with.

5. Your available hours per week now, and whether you can go full-time in two months.



I read every application that follows the instructions. Copy-paste applications and AI-written cover letters are obvious and go straight in the bin.

title: Part-Time Bookkeeper & Financial Records Specialist
description:

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and trustworthy Bookkeeper & Financial Records Specialist to manage the ongoing bookkeeping and financial organization for several small businesses and personal accounts.



Our businesses span spirits/importing and marketing, consulting, real estate/property management, and other entrepreneurial ventures. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the monthly bookkeeping process—not simply enter transactions.



The ideal person loves clean books, catches discrepancies, asks good questions, and can ensure that our records remain accurate and tax-ready throughout the year.



Key Responsibilities

Categorize and reconcile income and expenses monthly

Maintain accurate records in QuickBooks

Review credit card and bank transactions and identify uncategorized or incorrectly categorized expenses

Properly allocate expenses among:

The Mansa Company LLC

MansaSpirits

P31 Properties & Investments property management activities

Personal real estate activities

Consulting activities

Personal/itemized expenses

Track business expenses, inventory, reimbursements, owner contributions/distributions, and other transactions

Reconcile bank and credit card accounts

Identify missing receipts, duplicate transactions, discrepancies, or unusual activity

Maintain supporting documentation and organized digital financial records

Track expenses provided manually that may not appear in connected financial systems

Produce monthly Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, expense/category reports, and other reports as requested

Maintain books in a manner that makes year-end tax preparation efficient for our CPA

Flag potential bookkeeping or tax-related questions that should be referred to the CPA

Meet with the owner once per month to review the books, outstanding items, and financial reports



What We're Looking For

Demonstrated bookkeeping experience with small businesses

Strong QuickBooks Online experience

Excellent reconciliation and expense-categorization skills

Experience managing books for multiple businesses/entities

Real estate/property bookkeeping experience strongly preferred

Understanding of the importance of separating business and personal transactions

Highly detail-oriented and accurate

Comfortable identifying inconsistencies rather than simply processing transactions

Strong written and verbal English communication

Able to maintain strict confidentiality with sensitive financial information

Proactive, dependable, and able to work independently

Experience preparing clean year-end records for CPAs is strongly preferred

Time Commitment



Approximately 10 hours per month, with the potential for additional hours during year-end/tax preparation, reconciliation projects or as the businesses grow.

✓ Business and personal expenses are properly separated

✓ Financial reports are current and available

✓ Books remain organized and CPA-ready throughout the year

✓Inventory and financial reconciliation projects as needed



Our goal is simple: no scrambling at tax time.



To apply please include:

A brief description of your bookkeeping experience

Your experience with QuickBooks Online

Whether you have managed books for multiple businesses/entities simultaneously

Any experience with real estate/property management bookkeeping

An example of the monthly reports you typically provide clients

Your hourly rate

Your availability for approximately 10 hours per month

How you normally handle missing receipts, unclear transactions, and reconciliation discrepancies



Please begin your application with the words “CLEAN BOOKS” so we know you've read the complete posting.



We are looking for someone interested in building a long-term working relationship as our businesses continue to grow.

title: Senior n8n Automation Specialist
description:
ABOUT THE BUSINESS



We are a growing UK-based Airbnb and serviced accommodation company generating approximately £1.5 million in annual turnover.



We use a combination of property-management, guest-communication, pricing, accounting and productivity systems to manage our properties and team.



We are looking for an experienced Automation Specialist who can take ownership of identifying, building, documenting and maintaining automations throughout the business.



This is not a basic virtual assistant position. You must already have strong technical experience with n8n and be capable of working independently with limited instruction.



SYSTEMS YOU WILL WORK WITH



Our main systems include:



• n8n

• Enso Connect

• Lodgify

• PriceLabs

• Airbnb

• 

• Xero

• Google Workspace and Microsoft tools

• APIs, webhooks and databases

• AI tools such as ChatGPT and other language models



Experience with every platform is not essential, but you must be confident learning new systems, reading API documentation and determining what can be safely automated.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Automation Development



• Design, build, test and deploy reliable n8n workflows

• Connect systems using APIs, webhooks, HTTP requests and databases

• Automate repetitive duties currently completed by our operations, guest-management and finance teams

• Build workflows that transfer information accurately between our systems

• Create automated notifications, reports, task assignments and exception alerts

• Add error handling, retries, logging and monitoring to every important workflow

• Troubleshoot failed workflows and resolve problems quickly

• Maintain and improve existing automations



Business Process Auditing



• Review how our team currently completes its daily responsibilities

• Interview team members and map existing processes from beginning to end

• Identify duplicated work, delays, unnecessary manual steps and opportunities for automation

• Calculate the time, cost and potential benefit of proposed improvements

• Recommend which processes should be automated, improved or removed

• Create a prioritised automation roadmap for the business



Continuous Business Improvement



• Proactively identify new ways to save time, reduce costs and improve accuracy

• Suggest improvements without waiting to be given step-by-step instructions

• Research new tools and integration opportunities

• Develop new systems that improve the guest experience, team productivity and financial control

• Review completed automations to confirm that they are producing measurable results

• Continuously improve workflows as the business grows



DOCUMENTATION AND CONTROL



• Produce clear workflow diagrams and written documentation

• Record what each automation does, which systems it affects and who owns it

• Maintain secure records of credentials and connections using approved methods

• Create user guides and short training videos for the team

• Keep development and production workflows properly separated

• Maintain backups and version records

• Follow platform rules, data-protection requirements and approved API access methods

• Never use automations intended to bypass Airbnb, 
 or another platform’s restrictions



EXAMPLES OF POTENTIAL PROJECTS



• Automatically creating and assigning operational tasks from reservation data

• Producing daily arrival, departure and cleaning reports

• Alerting the team when important guest or reservation information is missing

• Monitoring unanswered guest messages and response times

• Synchronising reservation and property data between approved systems

• Automating owner statements and property-level financial reporting

• Matching invoices and payments in Xero

• Producing revenue, occupancy and pricing reports

• Identifying workflow failures before they affect guests

• Creating management dashboards and automated weekly reports

• Automating team quality-control and audit processes



ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS



• Strong practical experience building production workflows in n8n

• Experience working with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON and HTTP requests

• Good understanding of authentication, including API keys and OAuth

• Experience with JavaScript or Python for custom workflow logic

• Experience working with databases, spreadsheets and structured data

• Ability to design workflows with error handling, logging and alerts

• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving ability

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Strong attention to detail

• Ability to work independently and manage projects from idea to completion

• Ability to explain technical matters clearly to non-technical team members

• Reliable computer, high-speed internet and backup internet connection



DESIRABLE EXPERIENCE



• Previous work with Airbnb, serviced accommodation, hotels or property management

• Experience with Lodgify, Enso Connect, PriceLabs or similar systems

• Experience integrating Xero

• Experience with AI agents, large language models and prompt engineering

• Familiarity with PostgreSQL, Supabase or similar databases

• Experience with Git, Docker or self-hosted n8n

• Experience building dashboards and management reports

• Knowledge of UK GDPR and secure handling of guest and financial data



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



During your first 90 days, you will be expected to:



• Understand and document our main systems and processes

• Audit the team’s repetitive daily and weekly duties

• Identify and prioritise the strongest automation opportunities

• Repair or improve existing workflows where necessary

• Deliver several reliable, fully documented automations

• Establish monitoring and alerts for business-critical workflows

• Present a longer-term automation and improvement roadmap

• Demonstrate measurable time savings or reductions in manual work



WHAT WE OFFER



• ₱100,000–₱140,000 PHP monthly salary, based on experience

• Full-time, permanent work-from-home position

• Paid Philippine public holidays

• Paid annual leave and sick leave following successful probation

• 13th-month pay

• Performance and salary reviews

• Opportunity to take ownership of automation across a growing UK business

• Long-term career progression as the company and automation function expand



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



Please include the following in your application:



1. A short explanation of your n8n experience.

2. Links, screenshots or Loom videos showing at least three automations you personally built. Please remove or hide confidential client information.

3. For each example, explain:

    The original business problem

    The systems you connected

    The workflow you created

    How you handled errors and failures

    The measurable result

4. Describe your experience with APIs, webhooks, JavaScript, Python and databases.

5. Tell us which of the following systems you have used:

    Enso Connect

    Lodgify

    PriceLabs

    Airbnb

    

    Xero

6. Explain how you would audit a team’s daily work and d
 which duties should be automated first.

7. State your expected monthly salary and earliest available start date.

8. Begin your application with the words “AUTOMATE OVERNITE” so we know you have read the complete job description.



Applications without relevant n8n examples will not be considered.



RECRUITMENT PROCESS



Shortlisted applicants will complete:



• An initial interview

• A technical discussion about previous workflows

• A small paid practical assessment

• A final interview



The practical assessment will test your ability to understand a business process, design a dependable n8n workflow and explain your solution clearly.

title: Career as AI Operations Architect for Non-Profit: Build the Systems To Power Life-Changing Mentorship & Adventure Travel
description:
$3.00–$4.00/hour starting salary reviewed after initial 3 months. 

Full-Time

Flexible Hours



Paid Trial-to-Permanent Role with Outcome Bonuses, Full Career Training and Support, as well as Long-Term Career Growth Opportunity with our organisation



The Mission



We operate a Young Adult Mentoring Network built around Fun and Adventure Travel Experiences.



Our Non-Profit guides young adults through transformative journeys that combine mentorship, personal development, and real-world adventure.



Our programs connect mentees with mentors, organize adventure-based learning experiences, manage family and community engagement, and track personal growth outcomes, all while scaling to serve more young people across multiple regions of the world.



Now we're expanding our operations into the Philippines and we need a systems architect to build AI efficiencies into our operational backbone from the ground up. Your local cultural awareness will be a plus for this expansion.



You are not maintaining existing workflows. This role is about reviewing our proposals, then supporting our team in designing, automating, and scaling entire operations: mentor-mentee matching, program delivery, adventure trip coordination, member and volunteer management, social media ecosystems, webinars, and community engagement, across multiple countries and cultures.



You'll work directly with the directors. You'll have maximum autonomy (we run on Holacracy principles). And if you execute with creativity and dedication, you'll be promoted to AI Tech Team Leader, building and recruiting your own team.



What You'll Actually Build



Mentor & Mentee Management Systems  

Automated matching, onboarding, progress tracking, and lifecycle management across Brilliant Directories, GHL, optional tools such as Fusebase, social media tools. Many other tools you can experiment with, test, and help us decide which tools can best support our teams goals.



Program Delivery Automation

Scalable infrastructure to coordinate mentorship programs, track participation, schedule sessions, and measure personal growth outcomes. Same processes will be used and tested by all internal teams as well, for our own personal growth, bug testing etc.



Adventure Travel Operations

Automated booking workflows, trip coordination, participant communication, and pre/post-adventure engagement sequences



Member & Volunteer Management

Self-service portals, automated communications, and community engagement tracking



Donor Operations

End-to-end donation workflows, receipt automation, stewardship sequences, and retention systems



Social Media Operations

Automated content distribution, engagement tracking, and follower growth systems across platforms



AI Agent Workflows

Custom AI automations for mentor matching, participant support, content generation, and internal knowledge management

Integration Architecture

Connect GHL, Fusebase, calendar systems, webinar tools, and AI platforms into a cohesive, self-running operation



The goal: 

Build and maintain systems so reliable and well-documented that the organization scales without depending on anyone remembering to manually push buttons so we can focus on changing lives, not managing spreadsheets.



Who This Is For

You're not looking for a job where you wait for tickets and execute tasks.



You're looking for a role where you:



Own the problem, not just the task

Design systems that actually work when they scale 2x, 5x, 10x

Can propose new tools, kill inefficient processes, and implement better ones without micromanagement



Want your work to matter, to help young adults find direction, mentorship, and life-changing experiences



Are excited by the challenge of expanding operations into the Philippines using your cultural and local knowledge



Have experience (or strong aptitude to learn) with n8n, Make.com, Zapier, GHL, AI agents, API integrations, and workflow automation



Think in systems: 

Where is the bottleneck? 

What should we automate? 

What happens when this breaks?

If you simply connect apps and call it automation, this isn't for you.

If you are ready for the challenge to join a friendly/caring team to help us design operations that make mission-driven work easier to run, we want to talk.



Your Growth Path

Phase 1: Execute 3 paid trial tasks @ $3.00/hr

Phase 2 (Month 1 to 3): Full-time implementation role

Phase 3 (Month 4+): Review for AI Tech Team Leader Role and increased salary and performance bonuses tied to organizational growth metrics (members served, communities reached, lives impacted). Help recruit, train, and lead your own automation team.



We measure our team's success by: 

Number of young adults mentored, adventure experiences delivered, operational efficiency gained, and systems built that don't break.



The Stack You'll Work With



CRM & Membership: GoHighLevel (GHL), Brilliant Directories, Fusebase (experimental only)

Automation: n8n, Make.com, Zapier, APIs, Webhooks etc.

AI: OpenAI, Claude, Local AI (experimental only), custom AI agents, prompt engineering

Operations: Calendar systems, webinar platforms, project management, SEO,
 and social media marketing tools

Data: Airtable, Google Sheets, databases



You don't need to know every tool. You need to be confident with tech, fast learner, adaptable, think systematically, and build things that last.



The Structure



Reporting: Directly with founding directors (we are easy going, dedicated to the mission, yet want to have fun with you and our team along the way)



Autonomy: 

Maximum. We are implementing Holacracy, a self-management system, encouraging self leadership, self responsibility, distributed authority, no micromanagement



Hours: 

Flexible. Discuss your needs with us.



Start: 

Immediate



Your Commitment:

3 paid trial tasks  resulting in Permanent role with benefits if it's a fit



How to Apply



Do not send a generic cover letter.



Send us:



One specific system you've built (or would build) that reduced manual work and scaled operations. What was the problem, what did you automate, what was the result?



Your thoughts on our stack.

What's one high leverage integration or automation you'd propose on Day 1 for a mentoring/adventure travel operation?



Your availability

When can you start the trial tasks?



We're hiring fast. 

If you're a empathic team player, a systems thinker, who wants to build something meaningful that benefits young people who need your/our support apply now.





We value reliability, documentation, and systems that don't create dependency. 



Build something that helps us mentor more young adults through the life-changing experiences we provide.

title: CRO Specialist / Growth Designer (A/B Testing)
description:
We are a growing DTC e-commerce group and are hiring one person to own our conversion program: build product pages, landing pages, and offers, A/B test them, read the data, and ship the winners, every week. You will work directly with the founders, our media buyer, and our ad creative team. We have enough traffic to run several real tests every month, so you will see results fast. 



This is not a "make it look pretty" job. We care about revenue per visitor.



What You Will Do:

Build pages and funnels:

- Design product pages, advertorials / pre-landers, listicles, bundle pages, and upsell / cross-sell flows

- Build landing pages that match the ad angles that are scaling 

- Set up post-purchase upsells, the cart drawer, and checkout settings

- Keep a library of proven page templates and sections



Design and test offers:

- Test bundles, tiered pricing, quantity breaks, free-gift and free-shipping thresholds, and discount framing

- Run price and offer tests

- Calculate the margin impact before any offer goes live, no offer ships without a profit-per-order calculation



Run A/B tests:

- Keep a prioritized test backlog (hypothesis, expected impact, effort)

- Launch multiple tests per week, each with a written hypothesis and a clear success metric

- Calculate sample size before launch and run tests to statistical significance

- Keep a test log: what changed, dates, traffic, result, decision, learning

- Roll out winners everywhere they apply; document losers so we never re-test them



Analyze:

- Weekly review Shopify analytics: funnel drop-off by step, device, traffic source, landing page

- Review heatmaps and session recordings to find friction

- Mine customer support tickets, reviews, and surveys for objections and copy angles

- Monthly competitor check (pages and offers)



Report: 

- Weekly report: tests running, tests finished, results, next launches, RPV / CVR / AOV trend

- Monthly report: total lift, learnings, next month's backlog, recommendations for ads and creative

- Tell the media buyer which landers get traffic and at what split; feed winning hooks and objections back to the creative team



Your KPIs:

- Revenue per visitor 

- Profit per visitor / margin per order

- Conversion rate and AOV 

- Tests launched per month and win rate

- Add-to-cart rate and checkout completion rate



Requirements: 

- Experience building Shopify pages for e-commerce brands (DTC, dropshipping, or CRO / e-commerce agency)

- Built advertorials / pre-landers matched to specific ad angles

- You have run real A/B tests and can show results with numbers (CVR, RPV, AOV), including tests that lost

- You have run at least one price or offer test

- Comfortable with GA4, Shopify analytics, and Clarity

- You can explain sample size and statistical significance in simple words

- Good understanding of direct-response basics: hook, proof, objections, urgency

- Strong written English; clear, short reports

- Reliable internet, a good computer, and a quiet workspace

- Shopify Liquid / theme development knowledge



What We Offer:

- Full-time, long-term remote position

- Salary depending on experience, with room for increases based on results

- Real traffic, real budget, and real ownership of the test program

- Direct access to the founder, fast decisions, no bureaucracy

- Room to grow as the team grows



How to Apply:

1) Send your CV

2) 3 to 5 A/B tests you have run, at least one that LOST. For each test, include:

- Context: niche, page type, and rough traffic (sessions/day or orders/day)

- What data gave you the idea (heatmap, drop-off, survey, reviews, tickets)

- Your hypothesis in one sentence

- What you changed (control vs. variant, screenshots or a Loom are welcome as support)

- Tool used, traffic split, how long it ran, and sample size

- Result: CVR / RPV / AOV before and after, and whether it reached significance

- Decision: rolled out, killed, or iterated, and what you learned

You can hide brand names for NDA reasons. Relative numbers (for example "+11% RPV") are required.

3) Links to 2–3 live pages you built

4) A short answer to this question: "Tell us about a test you were sure would win, and it lost. What did you learn?"

5) A screenshot of a test log or weekly report you keep (redacted is fine)

6) If possible, a 3–5 minute Loom video walking us through one of your tests



Applications with no screenshots and no numbers will not be considered.

title: Shopify CX & Ecommerce Operations Lead — Australian Surf/Streetwear Brand (Founding Hire)
description:
GRVLN — FOUNDING CX & ECOMMERCE OPERATIONS LEAD



Start your application with: GRVLN CX



WHO WE ARE



We are GRVLN (Graveylane) — an Australian surf, swimwear and underground streetwear brand out of Sydney's Northern Beaches. 



Our thing is long, old-school-inspired performance boardshorts, plus women's swim and streetwear. The brand sits where surf, skate, graffiti, punk, rave and fashion overlap. It is not a dropshipping store and it is not a faceless catalogue — there are two of us, Blake and Dylan, we design the product, we shoot the content, and we have done nearly AUD $300,000 in about nine months while running the business badly on purpose because there was no one else to run it.



That is the honest pitch. The brand works. The operations do not yet. We are building a real team to fix that, and you would be the first person on it.



WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS



Right now customer
s and Instagram messages land on the two founders. That means a customer who is three weeks into a delayed order waits for one of us to finish a photoshoot before anyone answers them. It is bad for the customer and it is the single biggest thing stopping us from growing.



You are being hired to take customer experience off us completely and run it properly.



This is not a ticket-closing job. You will own the customer-facing side of the business: the inbox, the investigations, the registers, the follow-through, and eventually the training and quality control of the CX people we hire after you.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY OWN



* Our customer service inbox 
 — you run it, not us

* Reviewing AI-generated draft replies, correcting them, and sending only what is accurate

* Instagram customer-service escalations that come through from ManyChat

* Investigating Shopify orders properly — line items, fulfilment status, tracking, notes, history

* Checking order status across Shopify, carrier tracking and our 3PL (Williams) systems

* Coordinating with our 3PL on missing, short-shipped and stuck orders

* WISMO ("where is my order") enquiries — the bulk of the volume

* Approved returns, exchanges and refunds

* Faulty, damaged, incorrect and missing-item cases, including photo evidence

* Address changes and cancellations before dispatch

* Preorders and backorders — knowing what is actually coming and when

* Maintaining the list of customers owed a product we did not have in stock, and making sure they are contacted the day it lands

* Returns register and exceptions register — accurate, current, no gaps

* Triaging the queue by urgency and by longest wait, every single day

* Escalating serious complaints, chargebacks, threats, and anything legal or privacy-related to us immediately

* Logging every AI mistake and every missing SOP so the system gets better instead of repeating itself

* Improving the reply templates and the CX knowledge base

* A short daily report and a real weekly report



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (this is how you will be measured)



* Urgent cases are spotted the same day they arrive

* Routine enquiries answered inside the agreed service level

* The oldest unresolved customer wait gets shorter week after week

* Zero fabricated order information — ever

* Zero unauthorised refunds or promises

* Exception registers are accurate enough that we trust them without checking

* AI errors logged daily

* Repeat enquiries turn into SOP improvements, not repeat work

* Founder involvement in CX decreases every week

* Customers get replies that are warm, brief and correct



WHAT YOU MUST HAVE



* Real Shopify admin experience — orders, fulfilments, refunds, customer records

* Ecommerce customer service over
, at volume

* Order investigation experience — you can find out what actually happened to a parcel

* Returns and exchanges experience

* Tracking and fulfilment understanding

* Experience working with a warehouse, supplier or 3PL

* Excellent written English — natural, warm, brief. Not stiff, not corporate, not "Dear valued customer"

* Good judgement under pressure with angry people

* Spreadsheet and register accuracy — you do not lose things

* Comfortable using Claude or ChatGPT as a drafting tool while independently verifying every fact before it goes out

* Ability to write in an Australian brand voice: relaxed, direct, human



NICE TO HAVE



* Fashion, apparel, surf, skate or streetwear brand experience

* Gorgias, Zendesk, Re:amaze, Tidio or similar helpdesk

* ManyChat

* Meta Business Suite

* Airtable

* Slack

* 3PL / WMS software

* Experience training or QA-ing other support staff



TOOLS YOU WILL USE



Shopify · Google Workspace · a helpdesk · ManyChat · Meta Business Suite · Google Sheets · Airtable · Slack · our 3PL's portal · Claude / ChatGPT



WHAT WE DO NOT WANT YOU TO DO



You will not invent policy, promise compensation, or issue high-value refunds on your own. Those come to us. Everything else, we want you to d
 and move.



SCHEDULE



* Full-time, 5 days per week, after the paid trial

* At least 4 hours overlapping 9am–5pm Sydney time

* Reliable internet, and an actual backup plan for internet and power

* Be honest with us about your existing clients and commitments — we would rather know



PAY



* PHP 50,000 per month to start

* PHP 60,000 per month from the 90-day review, based on documented outcomes — not on time served

* 13th-month pay

* Further increases as you take on training and supervising additional CX operators

* If you arrive with verified 3PL/WMS experience and evidence you have supervised support staff before, tell us and we will talk about starting higher



HOW WE HIRE



1. Application (see below)

2. A paid practical test — about 75 minutes, paid PHP 1,500 on submission whether or not you get the role. We do not ask for free work.

3. A 20-minute interview

4. 14-day paid probation at full pro-rata salary. We use TimeProof during probation only, and we tell you that up front. After probation we measure your scorecard, not your mouse.

5. 30-day performance review, 90-day pay review



WHERE THIS GOES



This is the first hire in GRVLN's operations team, not a seat in an existing one. The person who does this well trains and quality-controls the next CX operators and becomes our Operations Lead. The SOPs you write will be how this department works for years. We are looking for someone who wants that, not someone waiting to be told what to do next.



Women are strongly encouraged to apply. Every role is open to all qualified applicants and we select on the published scorecard only.



WHAT WE ACTUALLY OFFER



* A real, growing Australian brand with real products and real customers

* Direct work with the two founders

* Long-term work — we are building a team, not filling a gap

* Clear expectations, real feedback, and credit when you do good work

* AI is part of the job, but your judgement and your verification are the point

* Paid tests are paid. We do not ask for speculative work.

* We would rather you tell us you made a mistake than hide it. Honesty here is a job requirement.



WE WILL REJECT, IMMEDIATELY



* Generic copy-paste applications

* Obvious unedited AI applications — we read a lot of them, we can tell, and it is an instant no

* Applications that do not start with GRVLN CX

* Anyone who thinks AI output can be sent to a customer without checking it

* Anyone whose first instinct is a discount or a partial refund before investigating

* Anyone who cannot explain how they would investigate an unfulfilled order

* Anyone who needs a founder to prioritise every task for them

* Claims of experience with nothing to back them up



TO APPLY



Start your message with: GRVLN CX



Then answer the scenario (this is the part we actually read):



"A customer writes: 'Where the hell is my order? I ordered three weeks ago and nobody has replied. If it isn't coming, refund me immediately.' In no more than five sentences, write your response, and then list the exact systems or records you would check before d
 what happens next."



And tell us:



1. Your current employment

2. Any existing clients or commitments

3. Your weekly availability

4. Your expected monthly salary in PHP

5. Your availability in Sydney time

6. Your Shopify experience — what you actually did in the admin

7. Your 3PL / WMS experience, if any

8. Which AI tools you use and how you check their output

9. Your internet speed

10. Your backup internet and power arrangement



Short, specific and honest beats long and polished. We read every application that starts with the code.

title: Lead Short-Form Video Editor — Australian Surf & Streetwear Brand (Founding Editor)
description:
GRVLN — FOUNDING LEAD SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITOR



Start your application with: GRVLN CUT



WHO WE ARE



GRVLN (Graveylane) is an Australian surf, swimwear and underground streetwear brand from Sydney's Northern Beaches. 



We make long, old-school-inspired performance boardshorts, women's swim, and streetwear. The brand lives where surf, skate, graffiti, punk, rave and editorial fashion overlap. Two founders — Blake and Dylan. Nearly AUD $300,000 in around nine months, with no editor.



That last part is the problem.



WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS



We film constantly. Surf trips, fashion, studio, rave, street, long-form talking pieces, UGC from customers. Then it sits on a hard drive because the two people who shot it are also the two people who would have to cut it.



We want an editor who is genuinely good — taste, not templates — so that footage becomes content within hours instead of never. You will be the founding editor, and if you are as good as we hope, you will eventually train and quality-control the clippers and editors we hire under you.



This is a taste hire. We are not looking for someone to churn out 200 subtitled clips a month.



THE LOOK



* Surfcore

* Underground streetwear

* Graffiti, punk, rave

* Editorial fashion

* Raw iPhone, dad-cam, VHS and archival textures where they suit

* Real, energetic, culturally aware



Never corporate. Never generic dropshipping-ad energy. Never over-polished just because the effect exists.



If you have watched good surf and skate edits, good fashion film, and good music content, you already know what we mean. If you have not, this is not your role and that is fine.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



* Edit Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts and paid-social variations

* Cut founder talking-head content

* Cut surfing, fashion, lifestyle, rave, art and adventure footage

* Pull the strong moments out of long-form video and podcasts

* Build multiple genuine hook variations — different opening shots, text hooks, captions, pacing, endings — not the same edit with a new first frame

* Protect the GRVLN visual identity in everything

* Use only B-roll we supplied or approved

* Keep projects and file naming organised to a convention

* Upload exports and project files correctly, every time

* Work in CapCut Teams or approved shared editing software

* Move fast when new footage drops — same-day response to an upload

* Deliver first drafts by the agreed deadline

* Keep a revision log with the reason for every rejection

* Turn our feedback calls into reusable training examples

* Maintain the GRVLN editing bible

* Read organic and ad performance feedback and act on it

* Remake winners intelligently, without producing pointless near-duplicates

* Eventually train and QA additional editors



HOW YOU WILL BE MEASURED



* Percentage of first drafts approved without revision

* Average turnaround from upload to first draft

* Revision rate, broken down by reason

* Hook quality — do the first two seconds hold

* File and timeline organisation

* Number of genuinely usable creative variations per package

* Organic retention and performance

* How many of your cuts become paid-ad candidates

* Training examples documented

* Whether you can raise the standard of the editors who come after you



WHAT YOU MUST HAVE



* A strong short-form portfolio — and it has to be relevant

* CapCut and/or Premiere Pro

* Real understanding of hooks and retention, not just terminology

* Excellent footage selection — knowing what to leave out

* The ability to explain why one opening is stronger than another. We will ask.

* Fast turnaround that does not destroy quality

* Clean, consistent file organisation

* Coachable. You will get repeated feedback and we need you to want it.

* Comfortable using AI to speed up work without handing over your aesthetic judgement



NICE TO HAVE



* Fashion, lifestyle, surf, skate, music or culture editing experience

* After Effects or DaVinci Resolve

* Sound design instinct

* Experience cutting paid social ads and reading their performance

* Experience giving other editors feedback



SCHEDULE AND HOW IT STARTS



* Paid editing test first — about 90 minutes, paid PHP 2,500 on submission whether or not you get the role. We do not use candidates for free work and we do not publish test edits.

* Short probation paid per approved video (PHP 1,100 per approved short-form edit) or clearly tracked hours — your choice

* Then full-time for the right person

* At least 4 hours overlap with 9am–5pm Sydney time preferred

* Reliable internet and a real backup plan



PAY



* PHP 50,000–75,000 per month full-time, depending on portfolio quality, speed and leadership potential

* We are publishing a range because editor value genuinely varies that much. If your reel is exceptional, apply to the top of it and we will pay it.

* 13th-month pay

* Review at 30 days, pay review at 90 days, tied to approval rate and turnaround

* Path to PHP 90,000 as founding editor running other editors



WHERE THIS GOES



Founding editor means the editing bible is yours to write. The revision log you keep and the feedback you record become the training material for every editor we hire after you. The strongest system-builder here becomes our Content Team Lead.



Women are strongly encouraged to apply. Every role is open to all qualified applicants and we select on the published scorecard only.



WHAT WE ACTUALLY OFFER



* A real Australian brand with real product, real surf, real trips — not stock footage

* Direct creative work with the two founders who shoot it

* Long-term work, and credit for the look you help build

* Clear feedback, quickly. You will never be guessing what we want for long.

* AI is part of the workflow; your taste is the part we are paying for

* Paid tests are paid. No speculative work.

* Tell us when something did not work. We prefer that.



WE WILL REJECT, IMMEDIATELY



* Portfolios dominated by gaming, corporate explainers, or work with nothing to do with culture, fashion or sport

* Template-and-effect showreels with no restraint

* Anyone who cannot identify the hook in their own edit

* Anyone who cannot show a project file or timeline

* Careless use of copyrighted music or footage

* "One long video = 100 quality clips" claims

* Export volume prioritised over approved quality

* Inability to follow a naming convention

* Defensiveness about revisions

* Unedited AI-written applications. We read a lot of them and it is an instant no.



TO APPLY



Start your message with: GRVLN CUT



Then send:



1. Your three best relevant short-form examples (links)

2. One shared editing timeline or a short screen recording showing how you actually work

3. Software you use

4. Your normal turnaround time

5. Your expected pay per approved edit

6. Your expected monthly full-time salary in PHP

7. Current clients and your availability

8. Your internet speed and computer specifications



And answer this:



"You receive a 45-minute founder vlog, 20 raw iPhone clips and a folder of approved B-roll. Explain how you would turn it into a master content package, how you would select hooks, and how you would keep every asset easy for another editor to find."



Be specific. We would rather read three sharp paragraphs than a page of adjectives.
