title: AI Research & Operations Virtual Assistant
description:
Hi! 👋



I’m looking for a full-time Virtual Assistant to join my early-stage software/IT company, Exyllion LLC, long term.



This is NOT a sales or appointment-setting position.



I’m looking for someone who can become a combination of an AI power user, researcher, operations assistant, content manager, organizer, and creative problem-solver.



I don't need someone who simply waits for a checklist every morning. I want someone who eventually understands the company well enough to identify problems, opportunities, better tools, and better ways of doing things.



🚀 ABOUT EXYLLION



Exyllion is an early-stage software/technology company.



I will share our company website with you so you can get a general feel for Exyllion.



If you visit the website and don't completely understand what the company does yet — that's actually okay!



The website was intentionally designed not to explicitly reveal the full idea and long-term direction behind the company. Some parts of what we're building and exploring are intentionally kept broad at this stage.



So please do not feel like you aren't qualified simply because you can't immediately figure out the entire business from the website.



If anything, being curious and asking "What exactly is behind this?" is a good sign. 😊



Once hired, I'll provide much more context about the company, the ideas we're evaluating, our projects, and what we're trying to build.



Right now, one of my biggest priorities is determining which opportunity should become the company's primary long-term focus.



This will actually be one of your first important projects.



I currently spend around 3 hours per day researching ideas, competitors, markets, technology, business models, and opportunities using ChatGPT and other AI tools.



The problem?



AI can hallucinate.



It can miss competitors.



It can present assumptions as facts.



It can tell me an idea sounds amazing without enough real-world evidence.



That's why I need a human researcher who knows how to use AI AND knows when not to trust AI.



You should be able to research the actual internet, verify information using multiple sources, investigate competitors, read customer discussions and reviews, organize everything clearly, and help me determine whether an opportunity is actually worth pursuing.



🔎 RESEARCH WILL BE A MAJOR PART OF YOUR JOB



You may research:



New software/startup ideas

Existing competitors

Market demand

Customer pain points

Pricing and business models

Industry trends

Potential customers

SaaS products and AI companies

APIs and software infrastructure

New technology

Reviews and customer complaints

Reddit, forums, and social media discussions

New AI tools

Automation opportunities

Potential vendors and partners

Software subscriptions and pricing tiers

Ways to reduce our software/AI costs

Ways to automate or eliminate repetitive work



Sometimes I may simply tell you:



"Here's an idea. Find out if this is actually worth building."



I want you to investigate it like a researcher — not just ask ChatGPT whether it's a good idea.



I LOVE people who can come back and say:



"I don't think this version will work, and here's the evidence. BUT while researching it, I discovered another opportunity that might be much stronger. Here's what I found."



That is exactly the type of thinking I'm looking for.



🤖 AI IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



You do NOT need to be an AI engineer or programmer.



However, you should be at least intermediate with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms.



Approximately 80% of our workflow will involve AI in some way.



You should know how to use AI for research assistance, brainstorming, data organization, content creation, writing, summarization, comparing information, improving prompts, analyzing information, creating reports, and automating repetitive tasks.



But most importantly, you need to understand:



AI output ≠ verified fact.



If ChatGPT tells you something important, I expect you to verify it.



🛠 FIND BETTER TOOLS & BETTER WAYS OF WORKING



I also want you to continuously look for tools that could make our company faster, cheaper, or more efficient.



For example, if we're paying for a tool and you discover another tool that does the same thing better or cheaper, tell me.



If we're considering purchasing software, I may ask you to compare features, pricing, subscription tiers, reviews, limitations, integrations, API availability, and alternatives.



Then recommend which option or tier makes the most sense.



If you discover something and think:



"This could save us 10 hours every week."



I WANT to hear about it. 😊



📧 BUSINESS
 & COMMUNICATION



You may also help manage and organize our business
.



This can include:



Organizing
s

Identifying messages that need my attention

Drafting responses

Sending approved routine
s

Following up when someone hasn't responded

Contacting software companies or vendors

Requesting information, pricing, or quotes

Scheduling calls

Keeping track of important conversations



Over time, this could potentially expand into vendor and partnership communication.



For example, in the future we may communicate with cloud/software/technology vendors such as AWS or other providers.



You might research available programs, credits, pricing, partnership opportunities, or discounts; contact the appropriate team; ask questions; compare offers; and potentially help with preliminary negotiations.



I would make the final decisions and approve important commitments, but you may help move conversations forward.



📚 ORGANIZATION & DOCUMENTATION



I have LOTS of ideas. 😅



I need someone who can help turn those ideas into organized information.



You may help maintain idea documents, research reports, competitor databases, business plans, tool lists, vendor information, project documentation, meeting notes, decisions, important links/resources, content calendars, research archives, and follow-ups.



If I send you a messy collection of ideas, links, screenshots, or notes, I want you to turn it into something structured, searchable, and useful.



Ideally, six months later we should still understand what we researched, what we decided, and WHY we made that decision.



🔍 FIND PEOPLE/EXPERTS WHEN NECESSARY



Sometimes internet research isn't enough.



You may occasionally help find industry experts, freelancers, consultants, potential users, developers/designers, researchers, or other specialists.



If we need real human feedback, you may help identify appropriate people or platforms where we can get it.



This could include finding paid research participants or experts when necessary.



You would NOT spend company money without approval. Your job would be to find the best options, compare them, and recommend what makes sense.



📱 SOCIAL MEDIA & AI CONTENT



You will also help with several content projects.



Our faceless YouTube content is heavily AI-generated. The goal is NOT to manually edit videos for hours. AI handles most of the production.



You may help with topic and competitor research, hooks, scripts, titles, thumbnails, keywords/SEO, uploading/scheduling, analytics, CTR, retention, and finding better content opportunities.



For TikTok/UGC, you may help create AI-assisted content, research trends and products, test hooks, prepare content, and analyze performance.



You may also help with Instagram and other platforms, including content creation, scheduling, research, and analytics.



IMPORTANT: TikTok and YouTube are NOT intended to become Exyllion's main business.



They're additional projects, experiments, marketing channels, and potential revenue streams.



Once we validate the strongest core opportunity for Exyllion, the software/technology business will become our primary focus.



🧠 WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



I care much more about how you think than having the perfect resume.



You should be extremely good at internet research, detail-oriented, creative, curious, comfortable with technology, comfortable using AI every day, able to verify AI-generated information, organized, flexible, able to learn new software quickly, comfortable with social media, good at written communication, able to organize messy information, comfortable contacting companies/vendors, and proactive.



Most importantly:



I want someone who THINKS.



If I tell you my idea, don't automatically tell me it's amazing.



Research it.



Challenge it.



Try to find reasons it could fail.



Find competitors I don't know about.



Read what real customers are saying.



Look for evidence.



And if you discover something better:



Tell me.



🌱 ABOUT WORKING WITH AN EARLY-STAGE STARTUP



My ambition is to build Exyllion into a multimillion-dollar technology company.



But I want to be transparent: this is an early-stage startup, and obviously nobody can guarantee that outcome.



What I can offer is the opportunity to join extremely early and potentially grow with the company.



Your responsibilities today may be very different from your responsibilities a year from now.



If the company grows, I would love for this person to grow with it and eventually take on significantly more responsibility.



I'm looking for someone who wants to become a long-term team member, not someone looking for a temporary one-month project.



💻 DO I NEED TO KNOW HOW TO CODE?



No.



You do NOT need to be a programmer.



However, Exyllion is a software/IT company, so you need to be genuinely comfortable around technology, software, SaaS, AI, websites, apps, APIs, and digital businesses.

title: Full-Time Surplus Funds Cold Caller / Client Acquisition Specialist
description:
I am hiring a full-time Cold Caller / Client Acquisition Specialist to work on a U.S.-based surplus funds recovery operation.



This is a sales and client-acquisition position, not a general administrative VA role.



You will work with leads provided through our business platform and CRM. Your primary responsibility will be contacting potential claimants, identifying the correct person, explaining the reason for the outreach, determining interest, qualifying potential clients, following up consistently, and moving qualified opportunities through our acquisition process.



You are not responsible for purchasing or independently sourcing the lead database. Leads and the necessary business tools will be provided.



What You Will Do

Make outbound calls to provided U.S. leads

Contact individuals who may be entitled to surplus funds

Identify and verify the appropriate claimant/contact

Follow provided scripts while communicating naturally and professionally

Clearly explain the basic reason for the outreach

Determine whether potential claimants are interested

Qualify interested potential clients

Obtain and verify necessary contact information

Handle common initial objections professionally

Consistently follow up with leads who do not initially respond

Re-engage previously contacted prospects

Schedule appointments or escalate qualified opportunities when owner involvement is required

Maintain accurate information and detailed notes in the CRM

Update pipeline stages and follow-up dates

Use available calling,
, SMS, and CRM tools according to company procedures

Prioritize promising opportunities

Track calls, contacts, conversations, interested claimants, qualified leads, appointments, and conversions

Protect confidential information and follow company procedures and applicable outreach/compliance requirements



Your primary goal is to consistently turn provided leads into qualified, interested potential clients and ensure that promising opportunities are properly followed through rather than forgotten.



Compensation



$600 USD/month guaranteed base salary



PLUS $100 USD for every successfully completed and collected deal attributable to a client you originated or materially handled through the acquisition process.



There is no fixed maximum on performance bonuses.



A performance bonus becomes payable after the company has successfully completed the applicable claim and received its corresponding fee.



Example Earnings



2 successful deals:

$600 base + $200 bonuses = $800/month



5 successful deals:

$600 base + $500 bonuses = $1,100/month



10 successful deals:

$600 base + $1,000 bonuses = $1,600/month



15 successful deals:

$600 base + $1,500 bonuses = $2,100/month



20 successful deals:

$600 base + $2,000 bonuses = $2,600/month



The base salary provides guaranteed compensation while the uncapped performance bonus gives strong performers the opportunity to earn substantially more.



Who I Am Looking For



You should have:



Excellent spoken English

A clear, confident, and professional speaking voice

Previous cold-calling, appointment-setting, telesales, lead-qualification, or client-acquisition experience

Confidence speaking with U.S.-based consumers

Strong follow-up skills

Professional objection-handling ability

Persistence and comfort with high-volume outbound calling

CRM experience

Excellent organization and attention to detail

Reliable high-speed internet

Backup internet preferred

Quiet working environment

Quality headset/microphone

Availability during agreed U.S. business hours



Experience with surplus funds, excess proceeds, tax overages, foreclosure, real estate, financial services, legal intake, insurance, or similar industries is highly preferred.



Previous surplus-funds experience is a major advantage, but it is not mandatory for an exceptional U.S. cold caller who is willing and able to learn the process.



What I Care About



I am not looking for someone who simply makes calls to complete a daily quota.



I want someone who actively manages the pipeline and takes ownership of follow-up.



If someone doesn't answer, you follow the appropriate follow-up process.



If someone expresses interest, you make sure the opportunity continues moving forward.



If an important opportunity requires my involvement, you escalate it quickly.



If a prospect needs another follow-up, you make sure it happens.



Your performance will ultimately be measured by the quality of opportunities and clients generated, not simply by the number of calls made.



Experience Requirements

Minimum 1 year of professional cold-calling, telesales, appointment-setting, lead-qualification, or client-acquisition experience

Previous experience calling U.S.-based consumers is strongly preferred

Experience with high-volume outbound calling and CRM/power-dialer systems

Strong objection-handling and follow-up skills

Proven ability to turn cold leads into interested or qualified prospects

Experience with surplus funds, excess proceeds, tax overages, foreclosure, real estate, financial services, legal intake, insurance, or similar industries is a major advantage



Candidates with 2+ years of relevant sales/cold-calling experience will be strongly preferred, but exceptional candidates with at least 1 year of experience are encouraged to apply.



About the Company



You will be hired to work with Exyllion LLC, a U.S.-registered company that operates and develops multiple business initiatives.



This position will initially focus specifically on our surplus funds recovery business line, with your work centered on outbound calling, client acquisition, qualification, pipeline management, and follow-up.



Long-Term Opportunity



This is intended to be a stable, long-term position.



As the business grows, strong performers may have opportunities for increased compensation and responsibility, including training other callers and eventually moving into sales or client-acquisition leadership.



I am looking for someone who wants to grow with the operation rather than someone looking for a short-term project.

title: Shopify Product Lister VA
description:
# E-commerce Virtual Assistant – Product Listings & Supplier Notes



We are looking for a reliable and detail-oriented **E-commerce Virtual Assistant** to join our team for a long-term position.



Our online stores are growing quickly, and we are looking for someone who can take responsibility for our **daily product listing process and supplier dashboard updates**.



This is not a temporary project. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with our business, become faster and more independent over time, and eventually take full ownership of the daily listing workflow.



## Your Main Responsibilities



**1. Daily Product Listings**



You will be responsible for adding new products to our online store every working day.



Currently, the workload is approximately:



* 15–30 new products per day

* Our short-term goal is to scale this to **40 products per day**



You will work according to our existing listing guidelines and SOPs.



Tasks may include:



* Creating and publishing product listings

* Adding correct product titles and descriptions

* Adding product variants

* Adding and checking product images

* Adding materials and product information

* Processing size charts

* Checking product information from suppliers

* Following our naming and formatting standards

* Performing a final quality check before completing a listing



Accuracy is extremely important. We prefer **30 correct listings over 40 rushed listings full of mistakes**.



As you become familiar with our systems and workflow, we expect your daily output to increase toward 40 products per day.



**2. Daily Supplier Notes Summary**



Our suppliers regularly leave important notes and updates inside our dashboard.



Every working day, you will:



* Check all new supplier notes

* Identify important issues or requests

* Create a clear daily summary

* Highlight anything that requires action or attention

* Send the summary to us at the end of your working day



The goal is simple: **we should be able to understand the important supplier updates without having to check the entire dashboard ourselves.**



## Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



* Reliable and consistent

* Very detail-oriented

* Comfortable working with repetitive tasks

* Able to follow detailed instructions and SOPs

* Comfortable working independently

* Good at written English

* Experienced with e-commerce or product listings

* Comfortable learning new software and dashboards

* Able to communicate clearly when something is unclear

* Interested in a long-term position



Experience with **Shopify and e-commerce product listings is strongly preferred.**



Fashion e-commerce experience is a big advantage.



## What Success Looks Like



During the first period, we will focus on **quality, accuracy and understanding our workflow**.



Once you are fully trained, the target will be approximately **40 completed product listings per working day**, while maintaining our quality standards.



You will also provide a **clear supplier notes summary every working day**.



We value people who don't simply complete tasks, but notice mistakes, communicate problems and help us improve the workflow.



## What We Offer



* Long-term position

* Stable daily workload

* Clear SOPs and instructions

* Training and onboarding

* Opportunity to grow with our e-commerce businesses

* More responsibility for strong performers

* Direct and clear communication with our team



We are building multiple e-commerce stores, so there is plenty of opportunity for the right person to grow with us.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your previous experience with e-commerce/product listings

3. Your experience with Shopify, if applicable

4. How many product listings you have handled per day in previous jobs

5. Your expected hourly or monthly salary

6. Your availability per week

7. Your internet speed

8. Your computer/laptop specifications



**Important:** Start your application with the words **“40 PRODUCTS”** so we know you have read the complete job description.



Applications without these words at the beginning may not be considered.



We are looking to start the interview and selection process **next week**.



If you are accurate, reliable and looking for a long-term e-commerce position where you can grow with the company, we'd like to hear from you.

* Maintain consistent content visibility

title: Experienced Credit Repair Dispute Specialist VA
description:
We are looking for an experienced Credit Repair Dispute Specialist VA to join our growing team long-term.



We are not looking for someone who only knows how to generate basic dispute letters. We want someone who understands credit reports, multiple legitimate dispute methods, client file management, and how to work as part of an organized remote team.



You will work directly with our team through DisputeFox, Slack, and GoHighLevel (GHL). Communication and organization are extremely important. You must be able to manage your workload, communicate with other departments, complete handoffs, update client statuses, and make sure the next person on the team knows exactly where each client stands.



RESPONSIBILITIES



* Review and analyze 3-bureau credit reports from Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion

* Identify inaccurate, incomplete, or potentially disputable information

* Determine the appropriate dispute strategy based on each client’s file

* Prepare and send dispute letters

* Manage multiple clients and dispute rounds

* Track deadlines, bureau responses, updates, and results

* Maintain accurate client notes and documentation

* Upload documents and results into DisputeFox/CRM

* Review results before beginning the next round

* Escalate complicated files when necessary

* Communicate with customer service, management, and other team members through Slack

* Use GoHighLevel to manage client information, tasks, pipeline stages, notes, follow-ups, and workflows

* Properly handle client/task handoffs between departments

* Keep Slack, GoHighLevel, and DisputeFox updated so the entire team stays on the same page



EXPERIENCE WE’RE LOOKING FOR



Experience with the following is highly preferred:



DisputeFox, Slack, GoHighLevel, traditional bureau disputes, CFPB complaints, BBB complaints, FTC identity-theft disputes when legitimately applicable, LexisNexis disputes, ChexSystems, Early Warning Services, LetterStream, credit report analysis, dispute-round management, escalation processes, and bureau/furnisher responses.



The more legitimate credit repair knowledge, systems, strategies, and experience you bring to the table, the better.



We especially want someone who understands how to manage a high-volume workload through Slack and GoHighLevel, communicate with different departments, stay on top of assigned tasks, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.



REQUIREMENTS



Previous credit repair/disputing experience is strongly preferred. DisputeFox experience is a BIG plus. You must have strong attention to detail, good written English, reliable internet and computer, excellent organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple client files and deadlines.



You must be comfortable working within a team environment and following established SOPs, workflows, scripts, and compliance procedures. All client information must remain strictly confidential.



We are building a long-term team and culture, not looking for someone who only wants a temporary position. We want people who are hungry to learn, dependable, team-oriented, and ready to grow. Strong performers will have opportunities to move up the ranks, take on more responsibility, and grow with the company.



HOW TO APPLY



Send your resume and answer ALL of the following questions:



1. How long have you worked in credit repair?

2. What credit repair software have you used?

3. Have you used DisputeFox? If yes, for how long?

4. Have you used Slack to manage your daily workload and communicate with a remote team?

5. Have you used GoHighLevel? What features have you worked with?

6. How many active client files can you comfortably manage?

7. List ALL dispute methods you have experience with.

8. Do you have experience with CFPB, BBB, FTC identity-theft disputes, LexisNexis, ChexSystems, Early Warning Services, and LetterStream?

9. Briefly explain how you review a new client’s 3-bureau credit report and determine your dispute strategy.

10. Have you worked in a system where customer service, disputers, and management hand clients/tasks off between departments?

11. What additional skills or knowledge can you bring to our team?

12. What is your expected hourly rate?

title: Content Writer & Researcher
description:
We're looking for creative, naturally curious writers to join our team for a long-term, full-time position.



This is not a traditional SEO writing role.



We're not looking for someone whose writing process is simply checking keywords, analyzing the top-ranking articles, and producing another version of what's already there.



We'll provide the topics and direction. Your job is to take an unfamiliar subject, research it thoroughly, find interesting information and angles, and turn what you discover into an article that's genuinely useful and worth reading.



What We're Looking For

Strong, natural writing

Excellent research skills

Genuine curiosity and willingness to learn

Creative and independent thinking

Ability to make unfamiliar or technical subjects interesting

Good judgment when evaluating sources and information

Attention to detail and fact-checking

Ability to explain complicated ideas clearly

Ability to take feedback and improve

Reliability and consistency



You don't need to be an expert in any particular niche.



In fact, being comfortable researching subjects you've never encountered before is an important part of the job.



We're especially interested in writers who naturally ask questions, go down research rabbit holes, and look beyond the first few results they find online.



What the Work Looks Like



We'll provide you with topics that we've already identified and researched for their potential.



From there, we expect you to think like a writer and researcher rather than simply follow an SEO template.



That might mean finding original sources, studies, reports, datasets, expert opinions, community discussions, firsthand information, or other useful material depending on the topic.



The goal isn't to write an article just because a search engine wants one.



We want to create articles that deserve to rank because they're genuinely useful and interesting.



Using AI



AI tools can be part of your workflow, but we're not looking for someone who generates an article with AI and lightly edits the output.



The research, thinking, judgment, fact-checking, and final quality of your work need to be yours.



We're hiring a writer and researcher, not a prompt operator.



Work Setup & Time Tracking



This is a full-time position requiring 40 hours per week.



We use Hubstaff for time tracking. While you're clocked in, Hubstaff tracks your activity/productivity and takes periodic screenshots.



We give our writers considerable freedom in how they research, write, and organize their work. Hubstaff is used to verify working hours and activity rather than dictate your research or writing process.



We expect writers to:



Track their working hours through Hubstaff

Complete 40 hours per week

Maintain a reasonable activity level while working

Complete assigned work and meet agreed deadlines

Communicate proactively if there are delays or problems



Your working schedule can be relatively flexible, but you should be available for occasional discussions or calls with the team when necessary.



Please only apply if you're comfortable using Hubstaff, including its screenshot and activity-tracking features.



Compensation



Starting salary: $800 USD/month



There is potential to increase this to $1,000 USD/month based on performance.



We're looking for people interested in a serious, long-term position rather than occasional freelance assignments.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a paid writing trial before we make our final hiring decisions.



How to Apply



Please complete our application form (remove spaces): 



The application includes a few questions about how you think, research, and write, along with two writing samples and a short writing exercise.



Please answer the application questions yourself. Do not use AI to generate your responses. We want to understand how you think and write.



Shortlisted applicants will be contacted directly regarding the next stage of the hiring process.



Applications sent through OnlineJobs.ph without completing the application form will not be considered.

title: 3D Artist – Character Modeling, Rigging & Warehouse Environment
description:
I’m looking for a 3D artist to create a rigged cat character and warehouse environments for my short student animated documentary, “Silent Shifts.”



I will provide reference images for the character and building.



CHARACTER MODELING AND RIGGING



* Create a grey-and-white cat maintenance worker wearing an orange safety vest, black work clothes, and work boots. The character must have no tail.

* Follow the supplied design and proportions.

* Create clean, animation-friendly topology, UVs, textures, and materials.

* Build a full body rig with easy-to-use controls, arm and leg IK/FK, and reliable skin weights.

* Include eye movement, blinking, jaw movement, and neutral, happy, and curious expressions.

* Make the hands suitable for holding a broom or dustpan.



BUILDING EXTERIOR



* Model a warehouse-style retail building based on the reference images.

* Include the facade, staff entrance, roller door, and car park.

* Make the staff door and roller door suitable for animation.

* Do not include company logos or branding.



BUILDING INTERIOR



* Model the main retail floor, shelving, restrooms, and staff break area.

* Use modular assets where practical and focus on areas visible in the planned shots.

* Keep the environment optimized for animation and rendering in Maya 2024.



DELIVERABLES



* Editable Maya 2024 files (.ma or .mb) containing the character, complete rig, and environments.

* FBX exports, including the character’s skeleton, skin weights, and facial blend shapes.

* All required textures with working file paths.

* Clearly named and organized objects and folders.

* A short demonstration of body movements and facial expressions, plus environment previews.



All files must open correctly in Maya 2024. Please specify any required plugins before starting.



TO APPLY

Please provide:



1. Relevant character, rigging, and environment portfolio examples.

2. Separate fixed-price quotes for the character and rig, building exterior, and building interior.

3. Your estimated completion time.

4. The number of revisions included.

5. Whether you can complete the full project or only specific parts.



This is a one-off freelance project for a student film. Please review the reference images and confirm the scope before finalizing your quote.

title: Part-Time Online ESL Tutor for Korean Children – Cebu or Lapu-Lapu Residents
description:
ABOUT PICK THE CLASS



Pick the Class is a Korea-based English education company providing personalized one-on-one lessons for Korean children.



Website: 



Our primary service is online English education. As the company grows, we are also exploring additional education services in Cebu, including in-person tutoring and locally based learning programs.



For this reason, we are currently accepting applications only from tutors residing in Cebu City or Lapu-Lapu City.



JOB DETAILS



• Teach Korean children through one-on-one online English lessons

• Conduct 30-minute or 60-minute classes

• Follow the provided curriculum and lesson materials

• Provide friendly, encouraging and age-appropriate instruction

• Maintain a consistent weekly teaching schedule

• Submit brief lesson feedback when required

• Communicate promptly with the Pick the Class team

• Conduct one or two promotional trial lessons per week

• Occasionally conduct an in-person lesson if requested by a student and arranged in advance



Most lessons will be conducted online. In-person teaching opportunities may become available depending on student requests and the future development of our local services in Cebu.



COMPENSATION AND GROWTH



• The starting teaching rate is ₱180 per hour

• The rate may increase up to ₱250 per hour through tutor-level promotions, teaching performance and incentives

• Tutor level and compensation will be reviewed based on teaching quality, student feedback, attendance, reliability and contribution to the team

• Long-term tutors may be considered for additional roles as Pick the Class expands its education services in Cebu



PROMOTIONAL TRIAL LESSONS



Tutors are required to conduct one or two promotional trial lessons per week for prospective students.



These trial lessons are offered free of charge to prospective students and do not receive a separate lesson fee. However, participation, teaching quality and student conversion results will be considered in performance evaluations, incentives and tutor-level promotions.



WORKING SCHEDULE



• Part-time, home-based position

• Classes are mainly held in the afternoon and evening, Philippine Time

• Tutors must provide their available days and teaching hours

• A fixed weekly schedule will be agreed upon before classes begin

• Applicants who can maintain a consistent long-term schedule are preferred



ATTENDANCE AND RELIABILITY POLICY



Pick the Class maintains a strict policy regarding lateness, absences and no-shows. Our students reserve a specific time and wait for their assigned tutor, so punctuality and reliability are essential requirements for this position.



• Tutors must attend every scheduled class on time

• Three instances of lateness will be counted as one absence

• A no-show without prior notice will be treated as a serious policy violation

• Attendance issues may affect incentives, performance evaluations and tutor-level promotions

• After two formal warnings, a third violation may result in termination of the tutoring contract

• In the event of a genuine emergency, tutors must notify the Pick the Class team as soon as possible

title: Social Media Coordinator
description:
Knightwing Media is hiring a Social Media Coordinator to help manage our growing roster of client social accounts.



We create photo, video, and social content for a wide variety of brands, and we’re looking for someone who genuinely understands social media. Not just someone who can schedule a post, but someone who knows what good content looks like, catches when something feels off, and can help make sure every brand we manage feels intentional and consistent.



What You’ll Be Doing



You’ll help manage the day-to-day organization and quality control of our clients’ social media content.



This includes:



Managing and maintaining multiple client social media calendars

Organizing content so posts are scheduled strategically and consistently

Reviewing captions before they are sent to clients or published

Quality checking social media videos before they go live

Making sure videos feel polished, engaging, and appropriate for the individual brand

Catching editing mistakes, spelling errors, awkward cuts, caption issues, branding inconsistencies, or anything that simply doesn’t feel right

Communicating revision notes to our editing team when changes are needed

Helping make sure content is formatted properly for Instagram,
, Reels, and other social platforms

Keeping track of client approvals, requested changes, and upcoming content

Understanding each client's individual voice so their social media never feels copy-and-paste

Staying aware of current social trends, editing styles, hooks, formats, and platform changes

We’re Looking for Someone Who...



Lives and breathes social media.



You should understand what makes someone stop scrolling, what makes a Reel feel current, when an edit feels dated, when text on screen is too much, when a hook isn't strong enough, and when a piece of content simply needs another pass.



You should also be:



Extremely organized

Detail-oriented

Comfortable managing multiple brands at once

Able to give clear, constructive creative feedback

Familiar with Instagram and
, especially short-form video

Comfortable learning different brand voices

Able to work independently and keep projects moving

Strong with spelling, grammar, and written communication

Comfortable working with social scheduling and approval platforms



Experience with social media management, content creation, video editing, marketing, or a creative agency is a major plus.



About Knightwing Media



Knightwing Media is a photo, video, and creative media company working with brands across a variety of industries. Our content ranges from real estate and hospitality to local businesses, lifestyle brands, commercial clients, and more.



Because our clients are so different, one of the most important parts of this role is understanding that every brand should feel like its own brand.



We aren't looking for someone to slap the same trending audio, caption formula, and editing style onto every account.



We want someone who can look at a piece of content and ask:



Does this actually feel like this client?



If you're naturally the person noticing why one Reel works and another doesn't, saving ideas on Instagram, watching trends evolve, and obsessing over the little details that make content feel polished, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Short-Form Video Editor With A Killer Eye (Casual, Ongoing)
description:
We run
 and Instagram video ads for live music acts and events, and we're looking for a short-form editor to join the team.



This is casual to start, around 3 hours a day, with more work for the right person as we grow. Where it goes depends on you: your eye, your attitude, and how you take feedback. The right editor can grow into a bigger role here over time.



You don't need music marketing experience. You need a great eye and a genuine love for editing short-form video.



What you'll be doing:



Editing short-form video ads for musicians and live shows. Cutting to music, building hooks that stop the scroll, and turning raw footage into ads that make people want to be in the room.



Must-haves:



- A strong portfolio of short-form video you've edited. Send links, and show me a range. It doesn't have to be music.

- You know what hooks someone in the first 3 seconds, and you know how to cut to music.

- You present your work in 
 (or similar) so the team and clients can leave feedback right on it. This is an absolute must!

- You only use footage, music and assets we have the rights to. No ripping clips, tracks or images from other videos or the internet. If you're not sure we can use something, you ask first.

- You work within Philippine business hours, and you're online for a stretch between 9am and 3pm PHT so we can talk live. Most of our team is in the Philippines and I'm in Australia, so we need that overlap for feedback and turnaround during the day.

- Really good written and spoken English. I give feedback over video, so you need to follow it easily and talk it through with me.

- You're happy to track your hours on a timesheet I'll provide. This work gets billed to clients, so accurate hours per client are non-negotiable. If that's a dealbreaker for you, this isn't the role for you!



Nice to have:



- Experience editing ads or music content.



Who this is for:



- You love editing. It's the thing you'd be doing anyway, job or no job.

- You watch an ad and think "I'd have cut that differently."

- You're proactive. You spot something that could be better and you fix it without being asked.

- You use your own judgement. I want to hand you footage and trust your calls, not answer twenty questions on every video. However, you strive to understand the objective from day one and if that is not clear you ask.

- You're hungry to make the best possible video, the one that gets the clickthrough and ultimately the sale.

- You learn from feedback, from our team and from the clients who comment on your videos. You don't have to be told twice.

- If a client hasn't given you enough raw footage to work with, you suggest what footage would make the video better and let us know early so we can communicate it to the client.

- You keep up with what's working in short-form right now, because it changes fast.

- You want to grow with a business and love what you're doing and who you're doing it with, not just "have a job".

- You operate with integrity. If you say you'll do something, you do it. And if something's getting in the way, you communicate it rather than going quiet or ghosting.

- You're enthusiastic and curious. You ask questions and you want to get better.

- You're kind and respectful, and always willing to help.



To apply:



- Start your message with the word SOUNDCHECK so I know you read to the end and can see your attention to detail.

- Send links to a range of your work.

- In your own words (no AI, please), tell me in a few sentences what makes a great video ad. I want to hear how you think, not what ChatGPT thinks.

- Tell me your expected hourly rate in USD.

Social Media & Content Manager



Role Overview



We are looking for a highly organised, creative and commercially minded Social Media & Content Manager to take ownership of our day-to-day social media and content activity.



This role will be responsible for turning the activity, ideas, projects and stories happening across the business into consistent, engaging content across Instagram, 
 and
.



The role goes beyond simply posting content. You will own the content process from planning through to publication, building a clear content calendar, writing copy, managing approvals and ensuring content is published regularly.



You will work closely with the owner to capture what is happening within the business and translate it into content that strengthens the brand, tells the story and grows our audience.



Key Responsibilities

* Develop clear content pillars and recurring themes aligned with the wider brand and business strategy.

Take day-to-day ownership of our presence across:



* Instagram

* LinkedIn

*

title: Tiktok Shop Manager - US Based Brand HIRING ASAP
description:
TikTok Shop Manager

Position Overview



We are looking for a TikTok Shop Manager to take ownership of the day-to-day operations, growth, and overall health of our TikTok Shop. This role is responsible for managing the store end-to-end—from catalog and product listings to promotions, fulfillment, compliance, affiliate coordination, customer experience, and performance reporting.



The ideal candidate is highly organized, data-driven, detail-oriented, and comfortable independently managing TikTok Shop operations while coordinating with founders, marketing teams, creators, fulfillment partners, and other stakeholders.



Key Responsibilities



1. TikTok Shop Management & Daily Operations



* Manage the TikTok Shop Seller Center and oversee daily store operations.

* Monitor shop health, account metrics, operational issues, and platform notifications.

* Maintain accurate store information, product data, SKUs, variants, pricing, and inventory.

* Identify operational issues and take corrective action before they impact sales or shop health.

* Maintain organized trackers, documentation, checklists, and standard operating procedures.



2. Product Catalog & Listing Management



* Create, maintain, and optimize TikTok Shop product listings.

* Manage product titles, descriptions, pricing, SKUs, variants, images, keywords, and other listing information.

* Optimize listings to improve product visibility, conversion, and sales performance.

* Conduct product and competitor research to support pricing and merchandising decisions.

* Ensure product listings comply with TikTok Shop requirements and applicable policies.



3. Promotions, Flash Sales & Campaigns



* Set up and manage TikTok Shop promotions, discounts, flash sales, bundles, and campaign activities.

* Coordinate pricing strategies and promotional schedules based on business objectives.

* Ensure products, inventory, pricing, and promotional mechanics are ready before campaigns launch.

* Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve GMV and conversion.

* Support store-wide sales initiatives and high-traffic promotional periods.



4. Inventory, Orders & Fulfillment



* Monitor inventory levels and coordinate product availability for campaigns and promotions.

* Identify potential stock-outs and inventory risks before they affect sales.

* Monitor order flow and fulfillment status.

* Coordinate with suppliers, warehouses, dropshipping partners, and fulfillment teams.

* Investigate and resolve fulfillment, shipping, and order exceptions.

* Ensure operational workflows remain accurate and efficient.



 5. Shopify & E-commerce Integrations



* Manage TikTok Shop integrations with Shopify and related e-commerce systems.

* Monitor product, inventory, and order synchronization between platforms.

* Troubleshoot integration and data-sync issues.

* Coordinate fulfillment workflows across TikTok Shop, Shopify, and third-party fulfillment systems.

* Maintain accurate operational data and tracking.



 6. Affiliate & Creator Management



* Support the recruitment, onboarding, and coordination of TikTok affiliates and creators.

* Manage creator sample requests and follow-ups.

* Track creator deliverables, posting status, content output, and affiliate performance.

* Review creator content for brand alignment and platform compliance.

* Support affiliate-driven campaigns and GMV growth initiatives.

* Maintain organized affiliate and creator tracking systems.



7. Shop Health, Compliance & Risk Management



* Monitor TikTok Shop account health and compliance metrics.

* Stay informed about platform policies, restrictions, and operational requirements.

* Identify potential policy violations and compliance risks.

* Assist with IPR infringement cases, product issues, and platform-related escalations.

* Maintain documentation needed to support compliance and operational decisions.

* Take proactive measures to protect the shop from penalties, restrictions, and avoidable operational risks.



8. Customer Experience & Reputation



* Monitor customer inquiries, reviews, complaints, and order-related concerns.

* Handle issues involving refunds, returns, shipping delays, product concerns, and order problems.

* Respond professionally to negative reviews and customer complaints.

* Manage escalations and ensure cases are properly followed through to resolution.

* Support customer experience during high-volume sales, livestreams, and flash-sale periods.



9. Performance Tracking & Reporting



* Track key TikTok Shop metrics including GMV, orders, product performance, affiliate activity, and campaign results.

* Maintain accurate reporting dashboards and operational spreadsheets.

* Analyze performance data to identify trends, issues, and opportunities.

* Provide regular reports and actionable insights to management.

* Recommend operational and growth improvements based on performance data.



10. Process & SOP Development



* Create, document, and improve SOPs for TikTok Shop operations.

* Develop repeatable workflows for listings, fulfillment, promotions, affiliate management, reporting, and customer support.

* Maintain operational checklists and trackers.

* Identify inefficiencies and recommend process improvements.

* Build scalable systems that allow the store to grow without sacrificing operational accuracy.



Required Qualifications



* Proven experience managing TikTok Shop operations.

* Strong hands-on knowledge of TikTok Shop Seller Center.

* Experience with product catalog and SKU management.

* Experience setting up promotions and flash sales.

* Understanding of TikTok Shop policies, compliance, and account health.

* Experience with order fulfillment, inventory coordination, and customer support.

* Experience working with Shopify or other e-commerce platforms.

* Strong Google Sheets and reporting skills.

* Experience coordinating TikTok affiliates and creators is highly preferred.

* Strong written English communication skills.

* Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

* Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.



Preferred Tools & Platforms



* TikTok Shop Seller Center

* Shopify

* TikTok Affiliate Center

* TikTok Creator Marketplace

* Google Sheets

* Kalodata

* Snowball

* Slack

* Canva

* CapCut

* Ownbase

* Aftership



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



* TikTok Shop GMV growth

* Order volume and sales performance

* Product conversion rate

* Product listing health and accuracy

* Shop health and compliance

* Fulfillment and order processing performance

* Inventory availability

* Promotional and flash-sale performance

* Affiliate/creator activation and content output

* Customer satisfaction and review performance

* Resolution time for operational issues

* Accuracy and timeliness of reporting



Ideal Candidate



The ideal TikTok Shop Manager is more than someone who simply maintains a store. They should be able to operate, troubleshoot, optimize, and grow the entire TikTok Shop ecosystem**.



They should be comfortable moving between Seller Center, product catalogs, promotions, fulfillment, analytics, affiliate management, customer issues, and compliance—and be able to recognize problems before they become expensive problems.



The goal is simple: keep the shop healthy, keep operations running smoothly, and continuously identify opportunities to increase sales and GMV.



 Candidate Submission Requirements



To help us evaluate your hands-on TikTok Shop experience, please submit the following:



1. Resume



Please provide a **link to your updated resume**.



2. Portfolio

3. TikTok Shops Previously Managed

* **Approximate Duration of Management**

> **Confidentiality:** If you cannot disclose the brand or shop name because of an NDA or client confidentiality agreement, please indicate this and provide a general description of the brand, product category, and scope of work instead.



4. TikTok Shop Experience



Briefly answer:



* How many TikTok Shops have you managed or supported?

* How long have you been working with TikTok Shop?

* Have you managed US TikTok Shops?

* What areas of TikTok Shop operations do you personally handle?

* Have you worked with TikTok Shop affiliates and creators?

* What tools and platforms have you used?



5. Optional Supporting Evidence



You may also submit screenshots, dashboards, reports, SOPs, campaign examples, listing optimization samples, or other work samples that demonstrate your experience.

title: Homeowner Outreach Specialist — Real Estate Acquisitions
description:
I run an off-market real estate acquisitions business. Every day we're calling homeowners who might be open to selling. Your job is to find out if they're interested and, if so, get them on my calendar for a follow-up call. Nothing to sell, nothing to close. Just qualify and book.



Day to day:



You'll dial using our auto-dialer, which queues up multiple numbers at once, so there's no manual dialing or looking up numbers yourself

Work our script. Open with whether they'd consider selling, work through the first round of pushback if they hesitate, and lock in an appointment on my calendar if there's genuine interest

After every call, log clean notes covering motivation, property condition, timeframe, and price expectations. We shorthand this as MCTP, and it's what makes an appointment actually useful to me

If anyone asks to be put on Do Not Call, flag it immediately. This is non-negotiable, every time

You'll have a daily number of dials to hit and a weekly target for appointments booked, both covered in training



What I need from you:



Spoken English that's fluent and easy to understand. This is a phones-all-day role

A quiet setup with stable internet and a headset, no background noise

Thick skin. Most people will say no, and that's just the job, keep dialing

Someone coachable. Before you go live, we'll walk through everything together on a shared screen

title: Mixing & Mastering QA Tester / Audio Engineer — AI Music Platform
description:
Company: JAFU Entertainment LLC / The Sync God

Position: Mixing & Mastering QA Tester / Audio Engineer

Type: Part-Time / Project-Based to Start

Remote



ABOUT THE PROJECT



The Sync God is a music technology platform designed to help artists, producers, songwriters and composers evaluate and prepare their music for sync licensing opportunities in television, film, advertising, sports, trailers, games and digital media.



We are currently expanding the platform with a new Mixing & Mastering / “Make My Song Sync-Ready” experience.



We are looking for an experienced mixing/mastering engineer with strong critical-listening skills to help test and quality-control this portion of the application before launch.



This is NOT primarily a software-development position.



We need someone who understands professional audio and can evaluate whether the actual audio results and user experience are good enough for professional creators.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Test our mixing and mastering application using multiple genres and different types of source material.

Upload and evaluate stereo mixes, vocals + instrumentals, and multitrack/stem sessions where supported.

Critically compare original vs. processed audio.

Evaluate tonal balance, low end, vocals, dynamics, transients, stereo image, clarity, punch, harshness, distortion, artifacts and overall musicality.

Evaluate mastering results for loudness, dynamics and translation.

Identify situations where processing improves the song, damages the song, or introduces audible artifacts.

Test different processing options/settings and document the results.

Verify that generated/downloaded audio matches what the user selected.

Test WAV/download workflows and technical deliverables.

Help determine whether the mixing/mastering results are commercially acceptable for a paid product.

Identify confusing instructions or controls from the perspective of a musician/producer.

Report bugs and unexpected behavior clearly enough that our technical team/AI development system can reproduce them.

Retest fixes and confirm whether issues have been resolved.

Help us establish a repeatable Audio QA checklist for future releases.

SYNC-SPECIFIC TESTING



Experience with sync licensing is a major plus, but not required if you are an excellent engineer.



We particularly want to evaluate whether processed music remains suitable for professional sync workflows, including:



main mixes

instrumentals

alternate versions

stems

clean/VO-friendly versions where applicable

60/30/15-second cutdowns where applicable

professional WAV delivery

preservation of musical dynamics and editability

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Required:



Real mixing and/or mastering experience

Excellent critical-listening skills

Experience working with professional WAV files and stems

Understanding of gain staging, EQ, compression, limiting, stereo imaging and loudness

Ability to recognize clipping, distortion, pumping, phase problems, harshness, poor low-end balance and processing artifacts

Good studio headphones and/or reliable monitoring environment

Ability to communicate clearly in written English

Strong attention to detail

Comfortable testing the same workflow repeatedly

Able to provide organized notes, screenshots and examples when something fails



Strong Plus:



Experience mastering for streaming, broadcast, TV/film or sync

Knowledge of LUFS, true peak, dynamic range and professional delivery formats

Experience testing audio software, plugins, DAWs or SaaS products

Familiarity with AI-assisted mixing/mastering tools

Experience with APIs or web-based audio applications

Knowledge of music licensing/sync deliverables

TO APPLY — PLEASE ANSWER THESE QUESTIONS

How many years have you been mixing and/or mastering professionally?

What DAW(s) do you use?

What headphones/monitors and audio interface do you use for critical listening?

Please provide 2–3 examples of music you personally mixed or mastered and explain exactly what you did.

Explain the difference between LUFS and true peak in your own words.

If an AI master sounds louder than the original but worse, what would you listen for to determine what went wrong?

What would you check before calling a WAV master professionally deliverable?

Have you ever tested audio software, plugins or web applications? If yes, describe your experience.

Do you have experience with music for TV, film, advertising, games or other sync licensing?

What is your hourly or project-based rate?



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the words “SYNC READY” so we know you read the entire posting.



INITIAL PAID TEST



Final candidates may be given a small paid test assignment using authorized test audio.



You may be asked to evaluate an original track against one or more processed versions and submit a short QA report explaining:



PASS / NEEDS IMPROVEMENT / FAIL



along with what you hear, why it matters, and what should be corrected.



We are looking for someone who can be critical and specific, not someone who simply tells us everything sounds good.

title: EyeCareWorks Virtual Assistant (US Optometry or Ophthalmology Experience)
description:
EyeCareWorks is a U.S. based placement company. Through our EyeCare Virtual Assistant program we train Philippine based virtual assistants and match each one with an optometry or ophthalmology practice in the United States. This post is for virtual assistants who have already supported a U.S. eye care practice and want a long term placement with one practice, working from home as their dedicated assistant.



HOW THIS WORKS

EyeCareWorks is the placement company, not the practice itself. If you pass screening and interviews, you complete our free eye care training (60+ hours) and earn the EyeCareWorks Virtual Assistant Certificate. We then match you with one U.S. practice. Placement depends on practice demand, so we cannot promise a start date. Paid hours begin on your first day with the practice, at $7.00 USD per hour, paid per tracked hour. You work as an independent contractor and register with the BIR once you qualify, using your own computer and internet connection. There are no application fees, placement fees or training costs at any stage.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Live virtual scribing during patient exams

 and video

• Managing the appointment calendar

• Updating patient chart records

• Back office administration such as fax and file management and transcription



WHAT WE PROVIDE

• Once placed: full time hours at $7.00 USD per hour, on U.S. clinic hours (night shift in the Philippines)

• A long term placement with one U.S. practice, rather than rotating between clients

• Free specialized eye care training, with no fees at any stage

• Fully remote work from your own home



REQUIREMENTS

• Experience as a virtual assistant for a U.S. optometry or ophthalmology practice

• Bachelor's degree, with proof of education

• Philippine citizen, residing in the Philippines

• Excellent spoken and written English

• Strong computer skills and the ability to multitask across systems

• A reliable computer, stable internet and a quiet home workspace

• Available full time for U.S. business hours, which are night shifts in the Philippines

• Highly organized, professional and patient focused



HELPFUL EXPERIENCE

• Practice management and EHR systems such as RevolutionEHR, Eyefinity, OfficeMate, CrystalPM, MaximEyes or Compulink

• Vision plan verification and prior authorizations with VSP, EyeMed or Davis Vision

• Patient recalls, contact lens and eyeglass orders, and optical support



EQUIPMENT

A Windows or macOS computer that meets our minimum specification, at least 10 Mbps DSL or fiber internet, a high quality headset with a microphone, and an HD webcam. The full specification is on our careers page at

title: GoHighLevel Revenue Automation & Sales Specialist

We are building a modern, automated sales operation and are seeking an experienced GoHighLevel specialist who understands that automation is not the objective—generating and converting opportunities is.



The Role



We are looking for a commercially minded GoHighLevel Revenue Automation & Sales Specialist to build, manage and continuously improve our sales and marketing systems.



This is not a programming role, generic virtual assistant position or traditional social-media marketing role.



You will take ownership of GoHighLevel, ensure every lead is captured and followed up, help generate new opportunities, qualify prospects, coordinate proposals and assist in closing straightforward sales.



The right person combines strong GoHighLevel experience with sales discipline, initiative and clear communication.



Key Responsibilities



GoHighLevel and Automation



* Build and manage sales pipelines, workflows, triggers and automations.

* Create forms, landing pages, calendars, campaigns and lead-nurture sequences.

What Success Looks Like

s and follow-up messages.

title: Head of Brand and Marketing
description:
About us

Ben's Fast Food Restaurants is a delivery-first restaurant group on a mission to make healthy food the most delicious, affordable food there is. We run four brands, Ben's Fast Food, Palmita, Umami Express and Lotus & Lime, out of 22 kitchens across 11 US states, with more opening. Every kitchen cooks all four brands for delivery, takeout and catering only; there is no dining room. Our food is made from scratch around vegetables and slow-roasted proteins.



We have grown to this size without a marketing team. The founder has done all of it himself. This role changes that.



The role

- You will be our first marketing hire, and you will own the brands. That means the brand story and point of view, a visual refresh, our four websites, our Google and Apple listings for every kitchen, social media for all four brands, campaigns, and local activation in our cities, all run remotely.

- This role is a contractor role, fully remote, with flexible hours. Some meetings will be in US time, but the bulk of your work can be done at your discretion.

- You report to the founder and you will get about an hour of his time each week. You set the agenda, bring the proposals, and run. If you need a manager to tell you what to do next, this is not the role.



- What you will not do: run paid ads on DoorDash or Uber Eats (the founder keeps those), answer customer reviews (our support team does), or build dashboards (our data warehouse and AI tooling supply the measurement; you read it and act on it).



What you will own

- The brand refresh, Ben's Fast Food first, working with a freelance designer you help choose. Ben's Fast Food has "fast food" in the name and sells bowls, salads and smoothies. Making that name an asset is job one.

- Brand voice and point of view for four distinct brands, and the campaigns and content calendar that carry them.

Instagram and other social accounts for all four brands: strategy, content, scheduling, community.

- The four Squarespace websites and every location landing page, including how we show up in search.

- Google Business Profile, Apple Maps and Yelp listings for every kitchen and brand: complete, accurate, on-brand.

- Photography and video: shot lists, art direction, hiring and managing local photographers and videographers in our cities, and editing for a consistent look across kitchens.

- Local activation designed by you and executed on the ground: creator seeding, partnerships with gyms, offices and community groups, and launch playbooks for new cities, run with our kitchen managers and local freelancers.

- The packaging inserts and the other touchpoints that move customers to order from us directly.

- Measurement: every campaign is pre-registered and read out with our analytics tooling, and you adjust from what it says.

- The marketing playbook itself, which you will write as you go.



Your first quarter

- Agree the scorecard and baselines with the founder.

- Audit and fix our Google, Apple and Yelp listings.

- Start the Ben's Fast Food refresh: identity, photo style, templates.

- Restart social on all four accounts with a monthly calendar and two measured campaigns.

- Build the launch kit for Brooklyn, Charlotte and St. Louis.



What we are looking for

- Seven or more years in brand, content or social marketing for US consumer brands, ideally including food or restaurants, with a portfolio we can see.

- Fluent in US culture, brands and social trends. You know what is happening on US feeds this month, not last year.

- Excellent writing and real taste. Witty when it fits, never corporate.

- Hands-on with Canva and the Adobe suite (Lightroom, Photoshop, Illustrator), Squarespace, Google Business Profile and Instagram's business tools.

- Experience briefing and managing photographers and designers remotely.

- Comfortable reading a metrics report and changing course because of it.

- A self-starter who is happiest with a lot of autonomy and very little management.

- Fluent English, a secure computer, fast and reliable internet, and at least three hours a day of overlap with US Central time.



Nice to have

- Spanish.

- Experience with delivery-only or multi-location restaurant brands.

- Experience in a small team where you did the work yourself.

Federal government agencies

Conduct interviews and working sessions with technical subject matter experts to gather information for proposal development.

Review and edit proposal content for technical accuracy, clarity, consistency, grammar, and compliance.

Develop and maintain reusable technical proposal content, solution narratives, Agile methodologies, technical resumes, corporate qualifications, and proposal boilerplate.

Incorporate feedback from technical, management, contracts, and business development stakeholders.

title: Part-Time Video Editor for Reels & YouTube | Color Grading
description:
I'm looking for a skilled, reliable video editor to turn raw footage into engaging Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and long-form YouTube videos. This role starts part-time, with the opportunity to grow into full-time work as our content needs expand and we build a strong working relationship.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Edit short-form videos with strong hooks, clear storytelling, and engaging pacing.

- Edit long-form YouTube content that flows naturally and keeps viewers engaged.

- Color correct and color grade footage, including matching shots, balancing exposure and white balance, and creating a consistent look with natural skin tones.

- Add captions, B-roll, music, sound effects, and simple graphics where they improve the video.

- Clean up dialogue and balance audio levels.

- Adapt content for vertical and horizontal formats, and export files ready for each platform.

- Keep project files organized, communicate progress, meet agreed deadlines, and incorporate feedback.



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR

- Proficiency in at least one of these editors: Final Cut Pro, Adobe Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve. You do not need to use all three.

- A portfolio showing both short-form social content and long-form YouTube editing.

- Solid color correction and grading skills beyond simply applying a preset or LUT.

- A good eye for detail, pacing, music selection, and storytelling.

- Clear communication, reliability, and the ability to work independently.

- A computer capable of handling video editing and a reliable internet connection for transferring footage.



HOW TO APPLY

Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph and include:

1. A brief introduction and the editing software you use most.

2. Links to 2-3 relevant samples, including a Reel or Short and a long-form YouTube video. Explain your role in each.

3. A before-and-after color grading example, if available, or a brief explanation of your grading work in one of your samples.

4. Your preferred hourly rate, weekly availability, and earliest start date.

5. Your typical turnaround time for a 30-60 second short and an 8-15 minute YouTube video, noting any assumptions about the footage and editing complexity.



I'm looking for someone who takes pride in their work and is interested in building an ongoing working relationship.

title: Experienced Immigration Legal Assistant
description:
Legal Assistant – U.S. Immigration Law Firm | Full-Time | Philippines



We are a U.S.-based law firm seeking a reliable, detail-oriented Legal Assistant located in the Philippines to join our immigration practice.



This is a long-term position for someone who is comfortable working independently, following detailed procedures, communicating with clients, and handling deadline-sensitive legal matters.



Work Schedule



Monday–Friday: 9:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. U.S. Central Time

Saturday: 9:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. U.S. Central Time



Applicants must be able to consistently work during these hours. Please consider the corresponding overnight hours in the Philippines before applying.



During scheduled working hours, you must be available and actively working except during authorized meal and rest breaks.



Responsibilities

Assist with U.S. immigration matters, including family-based immigration, adjustment of status, naturalization, removal of conditions, employment-based immigration, and consular processing

Assist with preparation of USCIS forms and immigration applications under attorney supervision

Collect, review, organize, and maintain client documents and supporting evidence

Review client files to identify missing documents and information

Enter and verify client information in legal and immigration case-management systems

Review forms and supporting documents for inconsistent names, dates, addresses, immigration history, and other discrepancies

Communicate with clients regarding questionnaires, documents, deadlines, appointments, and case status

Make and receive client telephone calls as needed

Prepare routine correspondence, client instructions, document checklists, and follow-up communications

Maintain accurate and organized electronic client files

Calendar and track deadlines and follow-up dates

Perform legal and factual research when requested

Follow established law-firm procedures and attorney instructions

Handle confidential and privileged client information appropriately

Required Qualifications

Excellent written and spoken English

Strong attention to detail and accuracy

Strong organizational and computer skills

Ability to work independently and manage multiple matters

Ability to follow detailed written procedures and instructions

Comfortable performing detailed and repetitive form preparation, document review, and data-entry work

Professional telephone and client-communication skills

Reliable high-speed internet connection

Quiet and private home workspace suitable for confidential client communications

Webcam

Dual-monitor workstation

Ability to consistently work the required U.S. Central Time schedule

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience working for a U.S. law firm

Prior U.S. immigration law experience

Experience preparing USCIS forms

Experience with Clio, Docketwise, or similar legal or immigration case-management software

Paralegal, legal assistant, law, or related educational background

Experience communicating directly with U.S. law-firm clients

What We Are Looking For



This position is best suited for someone seeking a long-term role with a U.S. law firm who takes ownership of assigned work.



We value:



Reliability and consistent attendance

Accuracy and careful attention to detail

Initiative

Responsiveness

Strong follow-through

Ability to identify missing information, inconsistencies, and potential problems without waiting for someone else to point them out



This is an operational legal-assistant position. A substantial portion of the work involves immigration forms, document collection and review, data entry, client follow-up, telephone calls, deadlines, and case-management responsibilities.



Candidates primarily interested in academic legal research or attorney-level legal work should understand that the primary responsibilities of this position are legal-assistant and paralegal support functions.



Work Environment and Video Availability



This is a remote position. Team members must be available by live video during scheduled working hours, except during authorized breaks.



You must:



Have a functioning webcam;

Maintain a quiet and professional workspace;

Be able to participate promptly in video meetings and work check-ins; and

Maintain a workspace appropriate for handling confidential law-firm and client information.



[If you actually want the camera continuously on, replace the paragraph above with:

“During scheduled working hours, team members are required to remain connected by live video with their camera on, except during authorized meal, rest, and personal breaks.”]



Exclusive Availability During Working Hours



During scheduled working hours, you must devote your working time exclusively to our law firm.



You may not simultaneously perform services for another employer or client, attend another job, or bill another client during the hours you have committed to our firm.



Outside of scheduled working hours, this requirement does not restrict other employment or freelance work unless it creates a conflict of interest or involves confidential information.



To Apply



Please submit:



Your CV/resume, including your U.S. immigration-law or U.S. law-firm experience;

A link to a 
 video introduction;

Your requested hourly rate in U.S. dollars;

Confirmation that you can consistently work the required U.S. Central Time schedule;

Confirmation that you have a dual-monitor workstation, webcam, reliable internet connection, and private workspace; and

Your earliest available start date.



In your application, please answer:



“Describe one U.S. immigration matter you personally worked on. Identify the immigration benefit involved, the USCIS forms involved, and specifically describe the work that you personally performed.”

title: Cold Caller / Sales Closer — Room Ready Supply - Commission-Based with a Path to Base Pay
description:
Remote · Full-Time · Commission-Based with a Path to Base Pay



About Room Ready Supply

Room Ready Supply (RRS) is a North Carolina-based hospitality and facility supply distributor serving 500+ hotels, motels, short-term rentals, cleaning companies, restaurants, campgrounds, RV parks, and facility operators across the East Coast. We supply the recurring essentials — paper products, cleaning supplies, linens, guest-room items, and more — backed by 1-business-day quotes, simple volume pricing, and a no-contract Reorder Program that keeps customers coming back.



We're building a dedicated outbound sales team to reach the businesses already buying these supplies from someone else — and show them a better way.



The Role

-We're hiring a Cold Caller / Sales Closer to own the front end of our sales pipeline: finding prospects, getting them on the phone, and turning cold conversations into booked Strategy Calls and closed orders. It's a performance-driven role with a clear, transparent path from your first week to a base salary.



What You'll Do

-Review assigned leads and research prospects before calling

-Make outbound calls, introduce RRS, and qualify each prospect

-Identify their current supplier, pain points, and purchasing volume

-Book Strategy Calls and follow up on prior conversations

-Keep the CRM updated and submit a daily activity report

-Close orders where possible and introduce customers to the Reorder Program



Expect to make 40–80 calls a day (roughly 200–400 a week). All calls are recorded — not to nitpick, but so we can coach you and sharpen the script based on what's actually working.



Compensation & Career Path

-A transparent, performance-based structure — you know exactly what it takes to move up at every stage:



Week 1 — Probation Close at least 1 deal, or secure 5 attended Strategy Calls, to move into the full-time role. Paid weekly, every Friday. No closed deal by the end of the week means an extended probation or a mutual parting of ways.



Tier 1 — Commission-Only 8% commission on every bulk order that's actually paid and processed. Commission-based only at this stage. Paid weekly, every Friday.



Tier 2 — Commission + Base Reached after 6 consecutive weeks of consistent closing — tracked as a rolling average of roughly 2 closed deals a week over that window. Once there, you earn 5% commission on every paid, processed bulk order plus a $300–$400/month base retainer, set based on performance review.



Uncapped commission at every tier.



A note on how commission is earned: commission is paid on orders once they've gone through and been charged — including reorders. If a customer cancels a scheduled reorder before it processes, that cycle doesn't count toward commission.



What We're Looking For

-Comfortable with cold calling and B2B sales

-Confident handling objections and setting appointments

-Can close a deal over the phone, not just book a meeting

-Organized enough to keep a CRM updated daily

-Motivated by clear, performance-based pay



Tools You'll Use

-GoHighLevel (CRM), a dedicated business phone line, and business
 — all provided.

Complete and submit this form -
